records.title: Director, Instrument Manufacturing
records.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The primary purpose of this position is to plan and direct departmental functions (Instrument Manufacturing, Engineering, Instrument Refurbishing) at the St. Louis Operations site to ensure achievement of the corporate goals and objectives of the worldwide bioMerieux organization. This position is responsible for the manufacture and maintenance of instrument production and refurbishment through oversight of multiple teams. In addition, this position: provides technical expertise and quality support through implementation of projects and continuous improvement activities; identifies and justifies projects for capital funding, and deliver the projects on time and budget. Also requires coordinating and overseeing the implementation of engineering projects related to cost improvements and new product introductions, ensuring cooperation within and outside the department at both the local and global levels. And finally, responsible for developing and maintaining an engaged, motivated and skilled production work force.

**Primary Duties**
==================

* Manage Manufacturing – Manage the manufacturing and refurbishment groups to ensure customer satisfaction. Deliver the forecasted product on schedule with no errors or nonconformities. Maintain the complex manufacturing process and minimize loss. Maintain high employee morale, drive cooperation between departments at both local and global levels, and drive employee career development.
* Manage and Maintain Production Equipment – Ensure that the manufacturing areas are maintained so that production can continuously manufacture and refurbish product. End result: Successfully manufacturer product to meet demand and improve efficiency to reduce the COGS.
* Product Transfer – Manage the transfer of new products from Research to Manufacturing. Validate the new processes to meet regulatory requirements and ensure the necessary procedures are in place to order parts / materials to meet market demand. End result: Successful market introduction of new, high quality products that meet all relevant and applicable regulatory requirements.
* CAPA Investigations – Manage and provide technical expertise to projects related to investigating failures in current product production or testing processes.
* Cost Improvement and Risk Management – Manage and provide technical expertise to justify and implement cost improvement projects in Operations.
* Finance – Ensure adherence to Departmental budgets.
* Personnel – hiring, maintenance, organization, engagement, and performance of qualified manufacturing, engineering, and other personnel.
* Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree required– Engineering, Supply Chain Management, R&D, Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience leading manufacturing operations, with budget oversight and demonstrated experience in cost reduction and operational efficiency.
* 3+ years experience managing operations in an ISO 13485 regulated manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformational change.
* Demonstrated experience in talent management and succession planning.
* Experience with capacity, automation, capital investments preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
====================================

* Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes.
* Comfortable giving clear, direct, and actionable feedback.
* Driving continuous improvement by evaluating processes and implementing necessary changes.
* Inspire and energize individuals to achieve their best performance.
* Drive for Results while successfully removing barriers.
* Communicates instructions clearly and effectively.
* Advanced Microsoft Suite Skills: demonstrates deep knowledge; manages complex tasks and integrates multiple tools independently.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
================================

* Direct supervision of approximately 1–5 employees.
* Indirect supervision of approximately 100+ employees.
* Required to make financial, manufacturing process, organizational changes, product and team development decisions.

**Working Conditions**
======================

* Domestic travel required: 10% of time
* International travel required: 5% of time
* Total travel: 15%

The estimated salary range for this role is between $155,000-$198,000. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMérieux’s bonus program. This range may differ from ranges offered for similar positions elsewhere in the country given differences in cost of living. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer.

In addition, bioMérieux offers a competitive Total Rewards package that may include:

* A choice of medical (including prescription), dental, and vision plans providing nationwide coverage and telemedicine options

* Company-Provided Life and Accidental Death Insurance

* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance

* Retirement Plan including a generous non-discretionary employer contribution and employer match.

* Adoption Assistance

* Wellness Programs

* Employee Assistance Program

* Commuter Benefits

* Various voluntary benefit offerings

* Discount programs

* Parental leaves

records.title: Director of Operations - Industrial Manufacturing
records.description:
PSG® is the global pump, metering and dispensing-solution expert, enabling the safe and efficient transfer of critical and valuable fluids that require optimal performance and reliability in applications where it matters most. Additionally, PSG is a leading provider of flow meters designed to reduce waste and downtime while accurately measuring, monitoring and controlling the distribution of fluids. Headquartered in Downers Grove, IL, USA, PSG is comprised of several world-class brands, including Abaque®, All-Flo™, Almatec®, Blackmer®, Ebsray®, em-tec®, Griswold®, Hydro™, Malema™, Mouvex®, Neptune®, PSG® Biotech, Quantex™, Quattroflow®, and Wilden®. PSG products are manufactured on three continents – North America, Europe, and Asia – in state-of-the-art facilities that practice lean manufacturing and are ISO-certified. PSG is part of the Pumps & Process Solutions segment of Dover Corporation. For additional information on PSG, please visit psgdover.com.

We thrive on winning and being number one; and are always looking to add the best and brightest to our talented team of professionals. PSG offers a unique combination of the both small company atmosphere: with an ownership mindset that allows you to make close-to-the-customer decisions; an innovative approach in seeing beyond what is possible today and entrepreneurial spirit in the pursuit of new opportunities; combined with benefits of a large company’s scale, tools, expertise, and financial strength with Dover. Join PSG, a growing global company where your curiosity, hard work and ambition is rewarded with exceptional career opportunities in a friendly & fast paced environment.

PSG is part of the Pumps and Process Solutions segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 65 years, our team of over 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible.

**Position Summary:**

 

Reporting to the site General Manager, the Director of Operations will manage the daily production, inventory, and logistics to ensure save, efficient, cost-effective, and timely delivery to our customers. They are responsible for development and implementation of strategy, growth, and profitability targets for the PSG-Grand Rapids facility. They will have direct ownership for established safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and lean objectives. Additional areas of reasonability include but are not limited to the oversight of: Safety, Plant Management, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Capital Equipment, Facilities Planning, Workforce Development, and Operations Strategy Deployment. A successful individual will deploy and maintain strong operational processes, be data driven, drive continuous improvement, and empower his or her team to solve problems.

 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

 

* Manage business to achieve/exceed agreed-upon growth, revenue, and operating income objectives
* Oversee end-to-end supply chain partnerships, warehousing, inventory management, and transportation
* Ensure products meet operations’ profitability goals
* Establish strategic direction, performance metrics, standards, and measurements for direct reports and the operation as a whole that support safety, quality, and delivery expectations
* Sets operational goals and objectives, and guides teams to meet monthly, quarterly and annual targets
* Partner with internal stakeholders to manage the P&L and continuously execute to achieve revenue and margin commitments
* Provide support and leadership to the supply chain, production planning, manufacturing, and continuous improvement teams by:
 + Supporting sales & operations planning (S&OP) process, and planning manufacturing capacity accordingly to ensure on time and efficient delivery
 + Identifying and responding to trends in the marketplace, anticipating and applying strategies to be ahead of the cost and quality curve
 + Planning and executing a best in class supply chain to ensure appropriate levels of inventory and turns as well as supplier quality and cost
 + Directing the continuous improvement program and supporting on site initiatives as required to ensure adoption of programs and achievement of desired results
 + Ensuring that products are delivered on-time to customers and that products meet all customer expectations regarding quality and performance
 + Planning and implementing capital improvements for the site and operations
* Work proactively with and effectively engaging functional counterparts to ensure overall organizational success and continuity of leadership
* Partner with union leadership to maintain compliance with the collective bargaining agreement while supporting operational goals
* Foster a positive employee relations environment through building a culture where employees are motivated and actively engaged in driving continuous improvement in the business
* Conducts performance evaluations, coaches and mentors, provides feedback, and takes action as needed to build a high-performing department
Embody the Company’s ethics and values; maintain the highest corporate governance principles 

**Qualifications** :

 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, operations management, or a related field is required
* MBA/Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred
* Minimum of 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or other operational leadership role
* Experience in a build to order/high-mix manufacturing environment required
* Proven background in the application of production/inventory control, procurement procedures and techniques, and logistics

This position is eligible to earn a discretionary bonus based on performance metrics and other criteria outlined in our applicable bonus plan.We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

Fraudulent Recruiting Disclaimer: Dover Corporation and our affiliated operating companies want to alert applicants to internet job posting fraud, where parties posing as Dover employees, recruiters, or other agents, try to engage with online candidates in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. We do not endorse or engage in any recruitment practices that involve payment or personal information outside of our official application and hiring process. Please verify the authenticity of an invitation to apply for a job, or for a job offer by contacting us directly through our Dover and affiliated operating company websites at https://careers.dovercorporation.com/ . To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice on our careers site.

Attention Applicants: If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please let us know. Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. Please contact accommodations@psgdover.com for assistance with an accommodation. Kindly specify Job Requisition Number / Job Title and Location in response.

records.title: Director Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing
records.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Greenbush
* Req ID:R52954
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently looking for a Director of Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing to join our Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) team. This leadership role is accountable for the aseptic filling operation for clinical and commercial drug products, including vials and syringes in both liquid and lyophilized formats. The Director owns the full filling value stream: materials management; preparation of equipment, format parts, and components; formulation of drug product and placebo; aseptic filling; and lyophilization. The Director also ensures a seamless handoff to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, syringe safety systems and autoinjector assembly, packaging, labeling, and serialization) and oversees facility cleaning and contamination control for the filling suites.

This role focuses on the start-up and execution of compliant GMP aseptic operations, ensuring the facility is properly staffed and trained, and supporting a dynamic, flexible production planning process that meets the needs of Regeneron’s patients. The Director will work directly with Drug Substance and Finish manufacturing management to ensure production timelines are met and will be a key member of various management teams within IOPS.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, NY
* Work model: Monday- Friday, 8am-4:30pm

**Discover your role:**

* Provides leadership, vision, and management to the Filling team and its supporting functions, and leads all aspects of Filling operations at the facility to manufacture commercial and clinical parenteral medicines according to approved protocols, regulations, and schedules
* Directly oversees aseptic filling of drug product and placebo into vials and syringes, in liquid and lyophilized formats, including stoppering, capping, and crimping
* Directly oversees formulation of bulk drug product and placebo, including solution preparation and sterile filtration
* Directly oversees preparation of equipment, format parts, and components to support aseptic filling, including washing, depyrogenation, sterilization, and setup of filling lines
* Directly oversees lyophilization operations, including loading, cycle execution, and unloading, as well as the management of materials and components required to support filling operations
* Directly oversees cleaning and sanitization of filling suites, including Graded space (Grade A–D) and Controlled Non-Classified rooms (iCNC), and supports the site contamination control strategy, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulations (media fills)
* Ensures a smooth, timely handoff of filled product to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, assembly, packaging, and labeling) in partnership with the leaders of those areas
* Troubleshoots and resolves issues impeding filling deliverables, including equipment performance, line interventions, and yield; provides technical input to resolve filling and aseptic process challenges
* Partners with department Directors and Project Management to implement new filling processes, including new formats, PFS and vial filling lines, formulation, aseptic filling, and lyophilization
* Manages department metrics and goals, monitors performance to objectives, and drives continuous improvement initiatives essential to meeting patient and business needs
* Leads the annual merit performance review process, builds departmental structure, and develops long-term staffing plans, including aseptic gowning qualification and training programs
* Collaborates with department Directors to support development of the annual budget, and rapidly and accurately communicates issues to department Directors
* Writes, reviews, and/or approves Standard Operating Procedures, specifications, regulatory filings, or other controlled documents as needed
* Executes Quality Management System assignments (CAPA, Deviation, Investigation, Change Control, etc.)
* Participates in the development and maintenance of a safe manufacturing environment and ensures that IOPS safety standards are maintained
* Oversees, supports, and participates in cGMP audits of all filling areas within the facility; maintains site inspection readiness and represents the filling operation during regulatory and client audits

**This role requires:**

* BS in any of the physical or biological sciences or chemical engineering, with biopharmaceutical/biotech experience in a GMP drug product production facility, including aseptic filling experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
 + Director: 12+ years of experience
 + Senior Director: 15+ years of experience
 + Level will be determined based on experience
* Experience overseeing aseptic filling operations in a biologics manufacturing environment, including vial and prefilled syringe filling
* Working knowledge of lyophilization, formulation, and aseptic technique, including barrier and isolator/RABS technologies
* Working knowledge of contamination control, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulation requirements
* Experience with multiproduct biologics facility start-up is preferred
* Experience interacting with multiple health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA)

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. This leadership role is accountable for the aseptic filling operation for clinical and commercial drug products, including vials and syringes in both liquid and lyophilized formats.

This role focuses on the start-up and execution of compliant GMP aseptic operations, ensuring the facility is properly staffed and trained, and supporting a dynamic, flexible production planning process that meets the needs of Regeneron’s patients.

records.title: Director of Engineering, Global Manufacturing Engineering & NPI
records.description:
The Director of Engineering leads Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM teams for a global data center rack manufacturing business. This role is responsible for engineering execution at the New Jersey manufacturing campus and for establishing global engineering standards, processes, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.

The Director drives manufacturing readiness, automation, operational excellence, quality, productivity, and successful new product introductions while partnering closely with customers and Platform Engineering. Platform Engineering retains ownership of product design, architecture, DFM approval, and Level 3 technical solutioning.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manufacturing Engineering Leadership**

* Lead Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Customer TPM organizations.
* Establish and deploy global engineering standards, SOPs, governance, and best practices.
* Develop engineering talent, succession plans, and organizational capability.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Own engineering performance for the New Jersey campus and drive global engineering consistency.
* Optimize manufacturing flows, capacity, labor efficiency, throughput, and cycle time.
* Deliver improvements in FPY, RTPY, DPPM, OEE, cost, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive KPI management systems and operational review rigor.

**Automation & Test Strategy**

* Define and execute factory automation and smart manufacturing roadmaps.
* Lead deployment of robotics, vision systems, automated assembly, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 solutions.
* Own manufacturing test strategy, test automation, diagnostics, traceability, and test system scalability.

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Own manufacturing readiness throughout all NPI phase gates.
* Ensure readiness of processes, tooling, automation, test systems, capacity, and staffing.
* Lead pilot builds, manufacturing validation, launch readiness reviews, and production ramps.
* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks to schedule, quality, and scalability.

**Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead customer-facing TPM teams and serve as executive engineering interface for strategic customers.
* Partner with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Customers, and Platform Engineering to achieve successful product launches.
* Align manufacturing capabilities with customer requirements and growth plans.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, and SPC methodologies.
* Lead cost reduction, productivity, yield improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.
Build a culture of accountability, standardization, and continuous improvement. 

 

**Ownership & Interfaces**

**This Role Owns**

* Manufacturing Engineering
* Process Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Test Engineering
* Test Automation
* Manufacturing readiness
* Factory readiness
* SOPs and engineering standards
* FPY, RTPY, DPPM, productivity, throughput, and operational KPIs
* Manufacturing validation and production ramp execution
Customer TPM organization 

 

**Partner Organizations**

**Platform Engineering**

* Product architecture and design
* Product specifications and BOM ownership
* DFM/DFA approval
* Product validation and qualification
* Design changes and reliability engineering
* Level 3 debugging, root cause analysis, and technical solution development

**Customers**

* Product requirements
* Acceptance criteria
* Product roadmap priorities
* Qualification and approval requirements

**Key Metrics**

* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Rolled Throughput Yield (RTPY)
* DPPM
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* On-Time Delivery (OTD)
* Productivity and labor efficiency
* Manufacturing cycle time
* Automation ROI
* NPI launch success
* Customer satisfaction
Global standards adoption 

 

**Qualifications**

* BS in Engineering required; MS/MBA preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing engineering leadership experience.
* Experience leading Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation, and NPI organizations.
* Proven success in high-volume electronics, server, rack integration, or data center manufacturing environments.
* Strong customer-facing leadership skills.
* Demonstrated track record improving FPY, RTPY, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
Lean Six Sigma and global manufacturing experience preferred. 

 

**Ideal Candidate**

A strategic and hands-on engineering leader capable of building a world-class global manufacturing engineering organization that delivers scalable NPI execution, advanced automation, operational excellence, and industry-leading quality for hyperscale and enterprise data center infrastructure products.

**About ZT Systems**
--------------------

At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, you’ll get to do work you are proud of alongside smart, passionate people. Every day, there are opportunities to collaborate with the best in the industry to design, build, and deliver impactful solutions to world-class customers. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment that’s challenging, rewarding, and career-defining.

A culture built around our values we work hard and think fast. We view challenges as opportunities—to do better, push harder, and be faster than we were the day before. When we fail, we learn from it and move on together. And when we succeed, we use the momentum to go even further. We create value with everything we do, building the foundation of today—and transforming the future of tomorrow.

Join ZT Systems and help us build technology infrastructure that connects the world.

**What We Offer** 
At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, we believe that investing in our people is key to our continued growth and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package designed to support your well-being, financial security, and professional development—both now and in the future.

**Compensation & Financial Security**

* Competitive base salary

* Performance-based annual bonus eligibility

* 401(k) retirement savings plan

* Tuition reimbursement for eligible education programs

**Health & Wellness**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with access to leading providers

-Mental health resources and employee wellness support programs-

* Company-paid life and disability insurance

**Time Away & Work-Life Balance**

* Paid time off (PTO) and company-paid holidays

* Parental leave and family care support programs

**Growth & Purpose**

* Structured training programs and on-the-job learning opportunities

* Matching gifts and volunteer programs to support causes you care about

These benefits are available to eligible employees and are designed to grow with you as your career evolves. Full benefits and eligibility varies by work location.

ZT Group Int’l. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. ZT Systems provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Please be aware that certain positions may require the applicant to either 1) be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or 2) be eligible to obtain an export control license or license exception from the Bureau of Industry and Science & U.S. Department of Commerce. All offers of employment will be conditional subject to the foregoing.

records.title: MRF Plant Manager
records.description:
MRF Plant Manager

*Emterra Environmental USA | Lansing Material Recovery Facility*

**Location**

Lansing, Michigan

 

**Reports to**

Process Improvement Manager

 

**Employment type**

Full-time, salaried

 

**Compensation**

$90,000 - $100,000 plus 10% discretionary bonus

**About Emterra**
-----------------

Every day, Emterra Environmental USA helps communities recover resources, reduce waste and create a cleaner future. For 15 years we have partnered with Michigan communities, businesses and municipalities to deliver reliable waste and recycling services. What began as Emterra Group's first expansion into the U.S. has grown into a team of 215 employees serving 75 communities across the state.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for an experienced MRF Plant Manager to run day-to-day operations at our Lansing Material Recovery Facility. You will manage and coordinate production, logistics and maintenance, keep the plant compliant with all safety, environmental, labor and corporate requirements, and hold profit and loss (P&L) responsibility for setting and achieving the facility's budget and production targets. You will also play a key role in plant improvements and special projects.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Supervise, coordinate and schedule plant staff and key operational personnel so the facility runs safely and efficiently.
* Optimize the processing of incoming recyclable material shift to shift, based on current intake volumes.
* Maximize daily production and uptime, increase productivity, minimize residue, audit inbound and outbound material, and produce commodities that meet buyer quality specifications.
* Own the plant's internal reporting, including daily bale counts, facility inspections, pre- and post-trip reports, daily MRF statistics and audit reports.
* Understand and monitor the flow of material through the system, and act proactively on suggestions and corrective actions to maximize throughput.
* Maintain maintenance calendars and logbooks for plant and mobile equipment.
* Have mechanical aptitude to ensure the daily trouble shooting and maintenance of the lines and to provide guidance to the maintenance team.
* Develop and manage the facility budget and production targets, and report on cost, throughput and commodity performance.
* Know and comply with all local, state and federal requirements for the facility and its operating permits and registrations, including MIOSHA and OSHA workplace safety standards and Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy (EGLE) requirements.
* Protect the health and safety of every worker by making all workers aware of known hazards and ensuring they are trained on all applicable equipment, processes and duties.
* Lead plant improvement and special projects, and work closely with Collections, Sales, Maintenance, Safety and Finance teams.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 5+ years of experience in a Material Recovery Facility (MRF), recycling, manufacturing or production environment, including 5 + years supervising a team production planning experience.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining the processing equipment (conveyors, screens, optical sorters, balers) and the mechanical processes with material flow.
* Working knowledge of MIOSHA/OSHA safety standards, including lockout/tagout, and of environmental compliance for a solid waste or recycling facility.
* Comfortable with data, reporting and Microsoft Office; experience with maintenance or production tracking software.
* A clear communicator and hands-on leader who can coach a team, hold people accountable and drive continuous improvement.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including early mornings, or evenings or weekends as plant needs require.
* Post secondary diploma or degree in a related field in operations, engineering, or business management.

**Why Emterra**
---------------

* Stable, year-round work in an essential service.
* Competitive salary and benefits package: medical, dental, vision, 401(k).
* A supportive team that backs you on the plant floor and across the business.
* The chance to make a real difference in your community and the environment.
* Growth opportunities with a company that has been investing in Michigan for 15 years.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Apply online at emterrausa.com/pages/careers or send to hr.us @emterrausa.com. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

*Emterra Environmental USA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, height, weight, marital status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available on request throughout the hiring process.*

records.description:
**Why you will love working at Maola Local Dairies™**:

* Built on over a century of dedication, Maola is always looking ahead investing in our people, strengthening our communities, and securing fresh, local dairy for the future.
* Join a farmer-owned cooperative rooted in integrity, sustainability, and a passion for providing fresh, high-quality Maola dairy products.
* We prioritize your well-being with competitive pay, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, and more
* Our employees are an integral part of who we are — what you do and what you think matters.

**SUMMARY:**

The Plant Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for all manufacturing at Maola Local Dairies – Philadelphia. 
 
You will execute strategies to optimize safety, food quality, performance, equipment reliability, cost-effectiveness, and profitability. You will build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement while developing a high-performing leadership team to drive sustainable results. This role requires a hands-on, results-oriented leader with extensive manufacturing experience, technical expertise in fluid milk processing and packaging, strong financial acumen, and proven success in a unionized facility. You must translate company goals into clear departmental priorities and ensure consistent execution across the entire plant.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**1. Operational Leadership & Manufacturing Performance**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily plant operations, ensuring production schedules, customer requirements, and business objectives are consistently achieved.
* Establish and maintain operational standards that drive improvements in production efficiency, OEE, throughput, yield, and order fulfillment.
* Demonstrate strong technical understanding of pasteurization, UHT processing, fluid milk manufacturing, and packaging operations.
* Drive equipment reliability and asset utilization through effective partnership with Maintenance and Engineering leadership.
* Establish disciplined management routines, performance reviews, and accountability systems to identify and eliminate operational losses.
* Ensure effective coordination between Production, Maintenance, Quality, Sanitation, Warehousing, and Scheduling.

**2. Financial & Business Management**

* Maintain full operational and financial accountability for plant performance, including operating budgets, labor costs, maintenance expenditures, material utilization, and manufacturing costs.
* Partner with department leaders to establish, manage, and maintain departmental budgets.
* Monitor plant financial performance against established budgets and proactively address unfavorable variances.
* Develop and execute cost-reduction strategies focused on eliminating waste, reducing overtime, improving labor productivity, and optimizing maintenance expenditures.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of plant P&L performance, cost per unit, conversion costs, and key manufacturing financial indicators.
* Ensure department heads understand their financial responsibilities and maintain ownership of their respective budgets.

**3. TPM & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the implementation and sustainment of TPM principles and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the facility.
* Establish a culture focused on identifying, understanding, and eliminating the root causes of operational losses.
* Drive improvements in equipment reliability, preventive maintenance execution, planned maintenance, and overall asset effectiveness.
* Challenge normalized deviance and reinforce adherence to established operating standards and best practices.
* Develop structured problem-solving capabilities throughout the leadership team and frontline organization.
* Establish meaningful performance indicators and management routines to measure progress, sustain improvements, and reinforce accountability.

**4. Safety, Food Safety & Quality**

* Establish and maintain an uncompromising commitment to employee safety, food safety, and product quality.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety programs, and manufacturing standards.
* Partner with Quality and Sanitation leadership to prevent quality failures, reduce product holds, minimize waste, and protect customer confidence.
* Ensure incidents, deviations, and nonconformances receive appropriate investigation, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Promote proactive employee engagement and leadership participation in safety and quality initiatives.

**5. Leadership, Organizational Development & Labor Relations**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a capable and accountable management team.
* Establish clear performance expectations and ensure department leaders demonstrate ownership of their respective areas.
* Build organizational capability through leadership development, employee engagement, succession planning, and effective performance management.
* Demonstrate authentic, approachable, and visible leadership throughout all levels of the facility.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented environment that encourages initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate the ability to effectively lead and develop a unionized workforce through constructive labor relations, consistent application of collective bargaining agreements, and proactive employee engagement.
* Establish productive working relationships with union representatives and employees while balancing organizational objectives, workforce needs, and contractual obligations.
* Address employee relations matters with professionalism, consistency, fairness, and sound judgment.
* Promote a culture of mutual respect, accountability, and shared responsibility for operational performance.

**6. Customer & Executive Engagement**

* Effectively communicate plant performance, business challenges, operational priorities, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Represent the Philadelphia facility professionally in customer interactions, audits, and business reviews as needed.
* Ensure customer commitments, product quality expectations, and service requirements remain central to operational decision-making.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Cenveo is a leading North American manufacturer of envelopes with over 100 years of experience and approximately 30 billion envelopes manufactured annually. We are committed to safety, quality, and operational excellence.

We are hiring immediately for an experienced Plant Manager for its envelope manufacturing facility in Chicago, IL. The position will report into the Site-Leader/General Manager.

Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, Cenveo provides competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager directs the manufacturing, maintenance, warehousing and distribution operations of a facility to achieve business goals including safety, quality, and production (including efficiency and profitability). They ensure compliance with all government regulations and corporate policies. Additionally, the Plant Manager serves as a liaison between the manufacturing facility and its clients, the Sales department, and other groups.

**Key Responsibilities** (\*Essential Functions)

*These are functions a qualified incumbent or applicant must be able to perform with or without reasonable accommodation.*

* Through direct action and the management of others, ensure the safe, productive, and profitable daily operations of an envelope manufacturing facility.
* Effectively use financial, & other, reports to monitor and improve facility performance on a variety of business related metrics. Prepare similar reports as required.
* Select, train, and develop subordinates necessary to conduct facility operations.
* Direct the plant supervision team in the enforcement and consistent application of policies, and plant rules which may include the terms of a collective bargaining agreement.
* Monitor, train and communicate safety and quality programs and ensure compliance with company policies and government regulations.
* Ensure the efficient and effective purchasing and utilization of all materials and services.
* Collaborate with sales to improve or modify existing products as needed, and to aid in new product development.
* Visit customer facilities, or host customer visits to the Cenveo facility to aid in sales, customer relations, or the resolution of problem situations.
* Monitor new trends and developments in business and manufacturing.
* Represent the company and facility in community relations functions.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Perform other duties as assigned based on business needs.

**Pay / Other**

* Salaried Pay Range: $120,000 – 140,000 annually
* Schedule: Monday – Friday; Saturdays required during peak production/business needs.

**Other (Non-Essential) Functions**

Includes functions which are normally performed by persons holding this title. However, these functions may be reassigned to other employees as part of a "Reasonable Accommodation" under the ADA.

* Other duties and assignments as required.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree preferred. Will consider experience in lieu of Bachelor's degree, emphasis on Manufacturing, Industrial Management, or similar preferred.
* Comprehensive experience in manufacturing, along with advanced knowledge in multiple related disciplines and processes is required.
* Experience in envelope, printing or packaging is highly preferred.
* Extensive experience Environmental, Health, & Safety.
* Six Sigma / Lean Manufacturing experience preferred.
* Managing teams or projects is preferred.
* Strong PC skills including Microsoft Office and internet research
* Strong interpersonal verbal and written communication
* Ability to work independently and with others, demonstrate analytical abilities, and be a strong and versatile leader.
* Must be a self-starter and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Ability to perform work, and resolve problems, that are complex and varied in nature.

**Physical Requirements & Environmental Conditions**

* Requires the ability to move throughout a manufacturing facility on a regular basis, including frequent walking of the production floor, climbing stairs, and navigating operational areas.
* Frequent exposure to manufacturing environment with one or more unpleasant or hazardous conditions including but not limited to dust, dirt, high noise levels, chemicals, etc.
* Ability to communicate effectively, hear, distinguish colors
* May occasionally reach, bend, grasp, carry, and lift and/or move objects weighing up to 50 pounds; manual dexterity as needed to perform job duties.
* Occasional travel may be required based on business needs.

**Employee Benefits**

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Holidays
* Vacation / Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee Referral Bonus Program
* Other Company Sponsored Benefits

**CENVEO IS AN EEO EMPLOYER**

Requirements:

* The minimum education requirement is some college coursework or Associate's degree. Bachelor's degree is highly preferred.
* Typically possesses 10 years of related work experience, with at least 5 years' experience in managing teams or projects. Requires advanced technical and business knowledge in multiple disciplines and processes.
* Extensive experience Environmental, Health, & Safety experience.
* Comprehensive experience in manufacturing is required. Experience in envelope, printing or packaging is highly preferred.
* Experience in Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing is preferred, but not required.
* Strong PC skills including Microsoft Office, Internet and Hagen.
* Excellent written/verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Must be able to work well with individuals at all levels within the organization.
* Must be a self-starter and must be able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment.
* Proven ability to perform work that is complex and varied in nature. Defines and discerns key aspects of problem and develops an integrated solution within a broad technical and business context of significant impact. May provide guidance/training to more junior staff.
* This position requires contact with employees, management, sales, account teams, call center, production staff, customer and vendors.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Plant Manager

**Company:** Smitty Bee Honey - Defiance, IA

**Reports to:** President

Job Summary

SBH is seeking an experienced, results-driven Plant Manager to coordinate and direct all major plant functions. You will oversee manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations while fostering positive employee relations and managing operational budgets. The ideal candidate will ensure strict compliance with SBH policies, food safety regulations, and legal requirements, while driving continuous improvement and on-time customer delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Operations & Production Management:** Oversee daily manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations, ensuring production schedules and product quality consistently meet specifications.
* **Customer Fulfillment:** Coordinate and communicate scheduled open orders to guarantee on-time delivery to all SBH customers, supporting strategic efforts to retain existing business and generate new sales.
* **Continuous Improvement & Efficiency:** Identify and implement initiatives to reduce labor costs, material waste, and indirect expenses. Develop and manage labor utilization strategies that adapt effectively to shifting production demands and deadlines.
* **Equipment & Facility Optimization:** Partner with Engineering and Maintenance to minimize equipment downtime. Manage process flows, optimize plant layouts, and coordinate shutdowns and startups for new production lines and equipment installations.
* **Food Safety & Quality Culture:** Champion a strong food safety culture by ensuring strict site-wide adherence to Food Safety, Quality, HACCP, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* **Workplace Safety:** Actively monitor, support, and enforce all plant safety objectives and regulatory standards.
* **Financial & Budgetary Oversight:** Consult with the SBH President on operational budgetary planning, forecasting, and disciplined spending.

records.title: Plant Manager (Yokosuka, Japan)
records.description:
**NORESCO, an OPTERRA Company**, helps customers modernize aging building systems and upgrade energy and water infrastructure to meet evolving demands. We implement innovative energy efficiency, distributed generation, energy storage, and renewable energy solutions that optimize the operational efficiency and improve resilience of buildings, campuses, military installations, and communities.

We are seeking an on-site Project Manager to oversee all preventive, corrective, and major maintenance activities (including repair and replacement work) at NORESCO’s 40 MW electric and thermal production facility at Yokosuka Naval Base, Japan. The cogeneration plant (CGS) is a critical asset for the base and daily operations are conducted by Navy personnel in partnership with NORESCO and our subcontractors.

NORESCO constructed the plant, which generates 50Hz and 60Hz power as well as a combination of Soft and Pure Steam, in 2008 under a Federal Energy Savings Performance Contract (ESPC). The plant pays for itself out of energy savings which NORESCO has guaranteed for the past 18 years. In order to meet our savings and availability guarantees, we employ a robust preventive maintenance program which relies heavily on Long Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) for all major pieces of equipment.

This is a Senior level position reporting to NORESCO’s Operations Manager and is administered through a 3 to 5 year International Assignment Agreement (IAA). This agreement is negotiated with each of our employees working Outside of the Continental Unites States (OCONUS). The agreement includes consideration for overseas pay, benefits, healthcare, housing, food, travel, vacation, stateside visits, relocation, etc., and is customized to the unique requirements of each new hire.

You will be the primary liaison between our NAVY customers, Japanese operators and subcontractors, as well as NORESCO team to ensure contractual obligations are met. While many of the team members in Japan speak English or are Bi-Lingual, some are not. Translators are available to facilitate conversations or process written correspondence as necessary. Japan is an amazing culture with many unique customs and protocols, a willingness to learn and adapt to their approach is an important part of your success.

It is of utmost importance for you to possess good listening, communication, and computer skills in addition to being proactive, organized, and having a bias for action. The Yokosuka Project Manager is supported by (and in-turn supports) many other NORESCO departments; Development, Engineering, Commissioning, O&M, M&V, Accounting, Legal, etc. Cross-functional technical skills, adaptability, versatility, and a quest for continuous learning and integration of advances are key in this position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Overall contractual responsibility for plant maintenance and repair activities through careful management of Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) and work orders.
* Ensuring subcontractor work is performed in a safe and professional manner with materials that meet or exceed applicable Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Regulatory standards.
* Participate in scheduled operations meetings and coordinate upcoming maintenance activities within the defined expectations and constraints of the customer and subcontractor availability.
* Prepare and distribute standard monthly reports (that summarize operations, maintenance, and repair activities) to NORESCO management, key customer contacts, and other stakeholders.
* Review plant operations logs, alarms, and performance data on a regular basis to evaluate equipment condition, collaborate with NORESCO team to identify potential issues.
* Perform plant inspections and safety walkthroughs during regular operations, confirm changes in equipment line-up, and subcontractor compliance with typical maintenance activities.
* Support Profit and Loss (P&L) management; assist with generating and maintaining the annual budget; capital expenditure planning; monthly forecasts, accruals, and variance analysis with development of recovery plans as needed to deliver the target revenue and profit.
* Review service agreements/proposals with manager; generate purchase orders as required; provide initial review and approval of invoices for materials and services.
* Collaborate with LTSA contractors to plan work and identify resources required for shutdown tasks such as parts, tooling, equipment, materials, and work procedures. Review and confirm subcontractors’ detailed work plans meet the customer and project needs.
* Maintain NORESCO’s Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to generate reports for maintenance schedules, completion status reports, equipment histories, and forecasts.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, visitors and customers to ensure protocols are followed on matters related to site access, security clearance, safety measures, and work permits.
* Monitor warranty programs to ensure the planned and required coverage is maintained by complying with all warranty requirements. Ensure warranty work is claimed in a timely manner, and all warranty issues are resolved to minimize out of pocket expenses.
* Monitor and analyze facility performance and host data for equipment and systems condition assessments. Review finings with Operations Manger and adjust maintenance plans accordingly.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelors degree, Associates degree, or equivalent Technical Training (ex; Navy Nuclear)
* 5+ years of experience in one of the following fields; electric power generation, cogeneration, industrial utility, or district energy industry with strong working knowledge of equipment
* Ability to obtain a Federal Security Clearance for work at Government facilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management discipline or equivalent experience
* High level communication, leadership, technical, and project management skills.
* Strong sense of ownership and focus on maintaining; a Safe work environment, Uninterrupted Plant operations, Quality control, Project schedule, Resolving issues in a timely manner, and consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.
* Graduate degree in engineering or business administration
* Strong interest in engaging operators, customers, and partners to grow relationships.
* Advanced knowledge of one or more facets of Engineering or Central Plants operations; design principles, technologies, equipment maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Energy optimization, utility rates, energy costs, applicable codes, design guides, and standards.
* Robust combination of business acumen, risk management, and strategic thinking skills.
* US military or DOD project management experience, Japanese language skills, and international work experience are a plus.

**Physical requirements include:**

* Ability to climb stairs and fixed ladders.
* Ability to access rooftops and elevated work areas while following safety protocols.
* Ability to work at heights and in confined or industrial environments as required.
* Ability to maintain balance and mobility while navigating mechanical, utility, and production areas.

**Compensation:**

* $130,000 – $150,000 per year, depending on experience + bonuses

**Benefits:**

* HSA Medical insurance, with a choice of 2 buy-up options
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* 100% Safe Harbor 401(k) match
* 100% company paid Life insurance
* 100% company paid Long-term Disability insurance
* Short-term Disability insurance
* Flexible Spending Account
* Commuter Benefits
* Legal and Identity Protection
* Pet Insurance Coverage
* Fertility and Reproductive Health
* Generous Paid Time Off, including Holiday, Vacation, and Sick Pay

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
***Position Summary***

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day leadership and performance of the machine shop operation. This position provides hands-on leadership across machining, production, quality, maintenance, safety, scheduling, and employee development to ensure the facility consistently meets customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

The Plant Manager will drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, standardized work, effective production planning, and development of a high-performing manufacturing team. This individual will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to support business growth and achieve operational objectives.

***Essential Functions / Responsibilities*****:**

**Operations Leadership**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily machine shop operations.
* Manage production activities to achieve customer delivery, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Establish and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly production goals.
* Ensure effective production scheduling, machine loading, labor utilization, and workflow.
* Identify and resolve production constraints, bottlenecks, and capacity issues.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to meet production requirements.
* Maintain strong floor presence and lead through visible, hands-on management.

**Machining & Manufacturing**

* Oversee CNC machining, manual machining, secondary operations, assembly, plating, Injection molding, deburring, inspection, and related manufacturing activities.
* Ensure equipment, tooling, fixtures, and processes are capable of meeting production requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to improve machining processes, cycle times, setups, tooling, and machine loading.
* Drive setup reduction, machine utilization, labor efficiency, and throughput improvements.
* Ensure adherence to standardized work and documented manufacturing processes.
* Lead Hazardous Waste Coordinator for facility.

**Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the machine shop.
* Implement and sustain 5S, visual management, standard work, waste reduction, and problem-solving methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, setup time, downtime, and overall manufacturing costs.
* Utilize data and KPIs to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.

**Safety & Environmental**

* Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Lead safety initiatives, audits, training, and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper machine guarding, PPE, lockout/tagout, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.
* Investigate incidents and near misses and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Hold employees and leaders accountable for safe work practices.

**Quality**

* Partner with Quality to ensure products meet customer and internal quality requirements.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, defects, and customer complaints.
* Ensure operators follow documented work instructions and quality procedures.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities.
* Promote a culture of first-time quality and process ownership.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, leads, machinists, operators, and other production personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, training, cross-training, and employee development.
* Develop a flexible, multi-skilled workforce capable of supporting changing production requirements.
* Conduct performance reviews and address performance issues in a timely manner.
* Foster teamwork, communication, accountability, and employee engagement.

**Maintenance & Equipment**

* Partner with Maintenance to maximize equipment availability and reliability.

records.description:
**ABOUT SOTERIA**

Soteria Flexibles is a leading manufacturer of custom short-run flexible plastic packaging, including liners, pouches and specialty films for healthcare, food and industrial customers across the United States and Canada.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Plant Manager runs the Carol Stream manufacturing site day to day and is accountable for its safety, quality, delivery, cost and people results. Reporting to the Vice President and General Manager, this leader owns extrusion, converting, packaging, maintenance and shipping, and turns the business plan into a safe, efficient, on-time plant.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Safety and Environmental:** Own a safety-first culture on every shift, lead incident investigations and corrective actions, and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA and applicable state and local requirements.

* **Production and Operations:** Direct daily extrusion, converting, packaging, maintenance and shipping operations to meet schedules and customer ship dates across all shifts.

* **Quality:** Maintain quality systems and inspection standards, drive down scrap, rework and customer complaints, and support customer, healthcare and food-contact audits.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead lean manufacturing, 5S and standard work, use data to find gaps, and build the case for capital projects.

* **People Leadership:** Lead, coach and develop supervisors and leads, partner with HR on hiring, attendance and employee relations, and communicate goals through shift huddles and tier meetings.

* **Financial Management:** Build and manage the plant budget with Finance, control labor, resin yield, scrap, maintenance and utility costs, and report results to the Vice President and General Manager.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations or Manufacturing Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience

* 7 or more years of manufacturing leadership experience, including 3 or more years leading a plant, department or multi-shift operation

* Experience in plastics, flexible packaging, film extrusion or converting

* Proven record improving safety, quality, throughput and cost in a union or non-union setting

* Working knowledge of OSHA requirements and safety program management

* Strong financial skills, including budgets, variance analysis and cost control

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ERP/MRP systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Hands-on knowledge of blown film extrusion and poly bag converting

* Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt, or equivalent training

* Experience with healthcare or food-contact packaging requirements

* Bilingual in English and Spanish

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Daily presence on the manufacturing floor; exposure to noise, heat, moving equipment and forklift traffic; PPE required in designated areas

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and lift up to 50 lbs occasionally

* Availability across shifts, with occasional evening, weekend or extended hours

**BENEFITS**

Soteria offers a challenging and rewarding working environment where employees are encouraged to develop and grow as professionals. The position also offers an excellent compensation package and a comprehensive suite of benefits.

* Medical, dental and vision insurance

* Paid time off and paid holidays

* 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match

The above description is intended to describe the general content, identify the essential functions, and set forth the requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $145,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

records.description:
POSITION TITLE: Plant Manager 
CLASSIFICATION: Exempt 
REPORTS TO: Plant Manager I 
SUPERVISES: Yes

POSITION PURPOSE: 
Responsible for overseeing and supervising the manufacturing and distribution departments by establishing, monitoring and enforcing policies and procedures to ensure that departments run smoothly and are aligned to quality standards. Creates and executes on strategies and policies for company growth. 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES: 

* Oversee and supervise the Manufacturing and Distribution departments.
* Provide for the timely manufacture and distribution of product against customer orders.
* Anticipates and tracks operational and tactical risks and providing strategic solutions.
* Plays a significant role in long-term planning, project status reporting, and implementing change control processes.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all published catalog items.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all custom manufactured items (RCC label)
* Provide monthly responses to budget variance.
* Provide for utilization planning by weekly reporting of the average Work-in-Process.
* Perform physical inventories of raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods.
* Provide for an appropriate balance of inventory to meet performance and financial objectives.
* Implement plant safety programs and ensure compliance with GMP.
* Confirm that appropriate work instructions are developed and maintained and followed throughout the business.
* Ensure that all ISO quality systems are followed.
* Provide compliance to ISO quality systems (i.e. Corrective Action)
* Oversee facilities and grounds maintenance.
* Oversees and reports weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual metrics.
* Identifies trends and assess opportunities to improve processes and execution.
* Completes reasonability testing and information validation prior to circulating findings and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Solicits and responds to feedback while gaining commitment and support.
* Stays up to date on industry regulations, trends, and technology.
* Manage and supervise employees, resolve problems, and make recommendations for staffing and interviewing candidates for employment.
* Responsible for annual personnel reviews.
* Champions Functional Training Document (FTD) program through employee learning and development initiatives; standards of excellence & leader/employee accountability.
* Other Duties as assigned.
* Commitment to the organizations values; High Standards, Bias for Action, Teamwork, Customer

Obsession, Trust, Accountability, Innovation and Growth & Learning. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description.

REQUIRED SKILLS: 

* Addressing operational concerns and issues, monitoring overall customer satisfaction.
* Developing and implementing operational procedures and policies.
* Analyzing training needs/requirements.
* Excellent interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate project activities.
* Ability to communicate with others effectively.
* Ability to conduct research for special projects, respond timely inquiries, and present written/ oral briefings.
* Ability to work with details and time-sensitive issues.
* Good decision-making skills and response to high-pressure situations.
* Managing processes, developing standard.
* Tracking budget expenses, financial skills.
* Performance management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: 

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry or Engineering-related discipline or a business-related area or equivalent work experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of eight (8) years manufacturing management experience supervising manufacturing employees.
* Minimum of two (2) years of recent overall project management experience.
* Knowledge of HazMat, ISO, Distribution and safety programs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills with the ability to manipulate spreadsheets, create pivot tables and summarize data from multiple sources
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently and with the team with strong follow through
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* A Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by the Project Management Institute (PMI) can be used in lieu of the educational requirements

WORK ENVIRONMENT: 
The physical environment may require the employee to work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions. This position may be working in the warehouse under various indoor environmental conditions, including supplemental heating in the winter months and without air-conditioning in the summer months. May be requested to work overtime and weekends. The position may occasionally be exposed to ruptured, leaking packages, some of which may contain Hazardous Materials. Where appropriate, proper safety equipment should be utilized and/or appropriate personnel notified. Frequently required to use personal protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials and chemicals. This job may require lifting of up to 50 pounds occasionally. 
INTENT AND FUNCTION OF JOB DESCRIPTIONS 
All descriptions have been reviewed to ensure that only essential functions and basic duties have been included. Peripheral tasks, only incidentally related to each position, have been excluded. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description. 
Requirements, skills, and abilities included have been determined to be the minimal standards required to successfully perform the positions. In no instance, however, should the duties, responsibilities, and requirements delineated be interpreted as all-inclusive. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. 
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, it is possible that requirements may be modified to reasonably accommodate disabled individuals. However, no accommodations will be made which may pose serious health or safety risks to the employee or others or which impose undue hardships on the organization. 
Job descriptions are not intended as and do not create employment contracts. The organization maintains its status as an at-will employer. Employees can be terminated for any reason not prohibited by law.

records.description:
### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans
* Short Term/Long Term Disability
* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/Paid Vacation
* Uniforms/Safety Shoes/Prescription Safety Glasses
* Healthy Lifestyles Program/ Virgin Pulse Fitness Tracker
* $500.0/Year Gym Membership Reimbursement100% Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program
* Income Protection Plans
* Legal & Travel Assistance Plans
* EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
* Wireless/Auto/Computer Discount Plans

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Production & Operations**

* Provide full production support, with a strong emphasis on converting machine performance.
* Maximize productivity and minimize downtime through effective resource management.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on PMs, MVP, and machine uptime goals.
* Oversee converting production, including equipment installation and major repairs.
* Support cost-reduction strategies and drive productivity improvements.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, safety protocols, and quality standards.

#### **Quality & Safety**

* Ensure plant focus on quality processes and tools for each converting machine.
* Maintain plant housekeeping standards and ensure machine cleaning programs are current.
* Drive safety initiatives and uphold OSHA, EPA, and company regulations.
* Oversee all audit protocols (third-party, customer, and internal).

#### **Leadership & Supervision**

* Directly supervise Converting employees and supervisors.
* Set and communicate quality, efficiency, and production standards.
* Provide training, coaching, conflict resolution, performance evaluations, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and high morale.

#### **Administrative & Strategic Support**

* Evaluate new methods, machinery, and safety programs; contribute to planning, budgeting, and purchasing.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels daily.
* Communicate issues to the General Manager in a timely manner.
* Remain on-call and available after hours to address urgent production issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* High school diploma or GED
* 10 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing
* 5 years of proven management experience in a production environment

#### **Preferred**

* College degree
* Experience with Ward Servo Pro Die Cutters, Bobst 8.2, and Gopfert Die-Cutters
* 5+ years in converting manufacturing operations
* 2+ years in a supervisory role
* Proficiency in Lean/5S, OSHA, EPA regulations
* Mechanically inclined with strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong project management and coaching abilities

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Sound mathematical and analytical capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effective meetings
* Emotional resilience and conflict resolution skills
* Positive leadership presence and professional demeanor

### **Performance Measurements**

* **Operating Standards:** Meets/exceeds performance goals for production and customer service
* **Personal Growth:** Achieves annual professional development goals
* **Employee Relations:** Demonstrates effective team development, coaching, and motivation
* **Creativity:** Contributes innovative ideas to improve business operations

### **Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

* Regular walking, talking, hearing; frequent standing and reaching; occasional sitting
* Visual requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
* Exposure to wet/humid conditions, mechanical parts, fumes/particles, and high noise levels

Requirements:

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 10,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is one of the largest corrugated packaging companies in America, with sophisticated manufacturing facilities in more than a dozen states. The company operates three of the most modern, cost effective paper mills in the country, as well as a series of sheet and box plants strategically placed throughout the United States offering a wide range of creative packaging solutions. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest." 
Pratt Industries offers competitive compensation plans with incentive opportunities, full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA, All State, Pre-Paid Legal, and 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, and paid holidays.
