records.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
records.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer-paid medical insurance
* Employer-paid dental insurance
* Employer-paid vision insurance
* Employer-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city

Adonis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

records.title: Senior Manager Operational Area Quality (Hybrid)
records.description:
**Job Description**

**General/Position Summary**

 

The Quality Assurance Senior Operational Manager is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance. The Quality Snr Manager will provide QA support of manufacturing operations, analytical laboratory operations and materials management for the external manufacture of Cell & Genetic Therapeutic programs. This role will drive, review & support activities related to product disposition including review of batch data, batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing and other quality systems documentation.

 

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for quality support of Vertex Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing operations across all phases of development, support of analytical laboratory, materials management and manufacturing operations.

* Responsible for GMP batch disposition activities including review and approval of batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing, materials review board and other quality activities as applicable to determine acceptability of product disposition.

* Partner with External CDMOs

* Provide QA support of change controls, process and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs.

* Responsible for approval of COAs and product labelling.

* Support review and approval of manufacturing documents such as technical and analytical protocols/reports

* Support technical transfer, and process performance qualification activities.

* Responsible for identifying compliance risks and gaps for GMP processes and supporting implementation of mitigating controls

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

* Act as a trusted advisor by providing compliance guidance through collaborative review and partnering with business stakeholders and contract manufacturers.

* Support the vendor management process including the creation and review of Quality Agreements with suppliers.

* Assist with addressing product complaints

* Maintain periodic batch record metrics and assists department with routine/quarterly Quality System data review metrics and reporting

* Execute improvements to QA operations procedure.

* Participate/ lead Cell & Genetic Program and Quality projects and drive continuous improvement activities.

 

**Required Education Level**

* Bachelor's degree in a biotech/ Lifesciences field.

* Preferred Master's degree or relevant comparable background.

 

**Required Experience**

8+ years of relevant industry experience such as manufacturing, quality assurance, and/or quality control in biotechnology/regulated pharmaceutical environment.

 

**Required Knowledge/Skills**

* Demonstrated experience providing QA support to GMP manufacturing operation
* Experience successfully leading event investigations, Root Cause Analysis and CAPA
* Experience with network-based applications such as Oracle, TrackWise, Veeva
* In-depth knowledge of both the conceptual and practical application of cGMPs in a pharmaceutical setting; Biotech/Cell & Gene GMP regulations and applicability. (e.g. EU, FDA, ICH, USP, etc. or other industry best practices ex. ISPE, WHO, etc.)
* Knowledge in Cell technology, aseptic manufacturing technology, analytical assays, cell & genetic therapies/Biologics processing, fill/finish and testing.
* Professional membership or equivalent in relevant societies, network of knowledge in cell and gene therapy industry.
* Ability to evaluate quality matters and make decisions utilizing risk-based approach
Ability to independently lead cross-functional teams, and effectively communicate with business stakeholders. 

 

**Other Requirements**

Up to 15% Travel may be required 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$133,800 - $200,600

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

#LI-Hybrid

**Company Information**

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

records.title: Director of Quality and Survey
records.description:
At Vetter Senior Living, our mission is simple: **Dignity in Life**. We are a premier provider of long-term care, assisted living, independent living, therapy, and home health and hospice services, and our team of skilled and caring people is committed to making quality service a way of life. Our work is guided by our values of Serving, Integrity, Teamwork, and Excellence.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Quality and Survey to provide quality and survey leadership and support to our communities. Through strong personal relationships, you will help our communities and service lines ensure that quality and regulatory requirements are not only met but exceeded. This role travels between communities and serves as a trusted clinical and regulatory resource for facility leadership.

### **Benefits**

* Student Loan Repayment Assistance
* Earned Wage Access
* Medical Insurance Options
* Vision Coverage
* Free Individual Dental Insurance
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* Leadership Development Opportunities
* Career Growth and Advancement
* Supportive Senior Leadership Team
* Great Place to Work® Certified Organization

**What You Will Do**

* Monitor compliance with federal and state regulations and maintain ongoing survey readiness in skilled nursing and assisted living.
* Identify potential deficiencies early and help facility leadership develop corrective actions.
* Conduct focused and routine audits of high-risk areas such as falls, wounds, infections, medication management, hospital transfers, documentation, and changes in condition.
* Manage the iQIES and HARP systems for the organization.
* Support facility Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) activities by identifying trends, establishing improvement plans, monitoring results, and evaluating whether interventions are working.
* Provide targeted education and coaching to Directors of Nursing, nurse leaders, and clinical teams when audits or quality data reveal knowledge or process gaps.
* Drive corrective actions such as staff education, coaching, focused chart reviews, and process changes.
* Serve as a clinical and regulatory resource to facility leadership on complex compliance, resident-care, documentation, or risk concerns.
* Partner with leadership while maintaining facility accountability for day-to-day operations.
* Promote continuous improvement in quality and survey processes and outcomes, and support all Vetter Senior Living service lines and growth opportunities.

**What You Bring**

* Licensed nurse (RN preferred).
Minimum of 3* -5 years of experience in post-acute care.
* Experience managing quality outcomes, with a strong understanding of regulations and survey preparation and management.
* Excellent communication and education skills.
* Strong organizational and relationship-building skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel between communities.
* High personal integrity, a caring attitude, and a genuine desire to work with and support others.

**Why Join Us**

You will be part of a highly respected team of skilled and caring people who are committed to making quality service a way of life. Your daily efforts will help our communities deliver exceptional care, and you will find fulfillment in building relationships, coordinating care, and helping enhance the dignity in people's lives.

**Ready to make a difference? Apply today to join the Vetter Senior Living team.**

records.title: Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production

postedPay.title: Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production

records.description:
**Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion.**

**If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then we would love to hear from you!**

—

**Who You Are:**

The Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production will lead the strategic planning, creative execution, and global production of visual merchandising activations across the Michael Kors retail network. This role is responsible for delivering innovative, brand-elevating experiences that drive customer engagement while ensuring operational excellence, fiscal responsibility, and flawless execution worldwide.

 

Working closely with Global Visual Experience, Store Design, Marketing, Creative Services, Supply Chain, and regional partners, the Senior Manager will oversee the end-to-end production lifecycle for seasonal campaigns, retail environments, windows, in-store experiences, and new store openings. This role will also lead vendor strategy, production innovation, and team development to support the continued growth of the brand globally.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and lead the global production strategy for all Visual Merchandising assets, while providing direct leadership and oversight for the North America region, ensuring alignment with brand, business, and market objectives.
* Own the performance and evolution of the global production function, including operating models, production capabilities, quality standards, vendor networks, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish scalable production processes, governance, and resource strategies that support current business priorities and future growth across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
* Serve as the strategic advisor to Visual Merchandising, Design, and Creative teams, influencing decisions related to feasibility, engineering, materials, fabrication, innovation, and investment priorities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance speed-to-market, scalability, sustainability, quality, and cost efficiency while maintaining brand integrity.
* Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and identify opportunities to simplify and modernize Visual Merchandising production process globally.

**Global Production Management**

* Lead the end-to-end production lifecycle for all global Visual Merchandising programs, including windows, props, visual tools, branded environments, animations, and special activations.
* Oversee planning, budgeting, fabrication, logistics, installation, and execution across retail, outlet, wholesale, and special project channels.
* Ensure all programs are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, craftsmanship, and brand consistency.
* Drive cross-functional project management across multiple concurrent initiatives, balancing competing priorities, business needs, and market requirements.
* Proactively identify executional risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery across regions and stakeholders.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

* Own global production budget planning, forecasting, capital investment recommendations, and overall financial performance.
* Develop cost optimization strategies and scalable sourcing models that improve efficiency without compromising quality, customer experience, or brand standards.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships with fabricators, printers, logistics providers, installation partners, and other key vendors worldwide.
* Establish vendor performance metrics, accountability measures, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure best-in-class execution.
* Evaluate production investments, operating models, and resource requirements, providing recommendations based on business impact, risk, and return on investment.

**Executive Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the senior production partner to Visual Merchandising, Store Design, Marketing, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional leadership teams.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations, business acumen, and a comprehensive understanding of brand, customer, operational, and financial priorities.
* Build alignment across functions and regions while balancing competing priorities to achieve the best overall business outcome.
* Represent the production function in senior leadership discussions, ensuring production considerations are incorporated into broader business planning.
* Lead organizational change initiatives and drive adoption of new processes, technologies, and ways of working that improve operational effectiveness globally.

**Team & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing production team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build organizational capability by developing future leaders, strengthening succession plans, and creating scalable ways of working.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operating rhythms, and development plans that enable increasing levels of ownership and autonomy across the team.
* Allocate resources strategically to ensure effective execution across a complex portfolio of global initiatives.
Create an environment where proactive problem-solving, strategic thinking, and enterprise leadership are expected at all levels. 

 

**You’ll Need to Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production Management, Design, Construction Management or a related field.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management credentials preferred.
* 7-10 years of progressive experience in visual production, retail marketing production, environmental design, experiential production, or related fields.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing high-performing teams in a global environment.
* Proven success leading large-scale, multi-market production programs within a premium or luxury retail organization.
* Strong expertise in project management, fabrication, print production, logistics, and installation processes.
Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets and complex vendor ecosystems. 

 

**We’d Love to See:**

* Exceptional leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate creative vision into operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Expertise in vendor negotiations, contract management, and cost optimization.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen.
* Highly collaborative with experience working across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, project management platforms, and collaborative workplace tools.

—

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Company’s policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, military status, disability, genetic information or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories.

At Capri Holdings Limited, we are committed to providing a fair and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation for the interview or application process, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at CapriTalentAcquisition@CapriHoldings.com.

In compliance with certain Pay Transparency laws, employers are required to disclose a compensation range. The range for this position will vary based on role requirements, skill set, and years of experience. Please note that for salaried roles, the figures reflect full-time equivalency, while for hourly roles, the figures represent the applicable hourly rate.

Compensation Range:

140,000.00 - 150,000.00 USD

records.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities** **:**

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

* Establish clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering team members. Provide regular coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve process capabilities to achieve required levels of quality, reliability, throughput, capacity, and cost.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, including work instructions, PFMEA, Control Plans, process specifications, and other applicable manufacturing documentation.

* Lead engineering efforts to identify and eliminate process variation, defects, scrap, rework, downtime, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency.

* Use data-driven problem-solving and appropriate engineering methodologies, including statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root-cause analysis, and structured corrective action, to resolve complex manufacturing issues.

* Develop and maintain appropriate engineering and manufacturing performance metrics.

OEE, scrap, and yield to name a few

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, problem solving, and ownership within the engineering organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, standards, and best practices and share lessons learned across the organization.

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality-system, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Build effective relationships with internal and external customers, suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and other technical partners as required.

* Communicate engineering priorities, project status, risks, resource requirements, and recommendations effectively to site and senior leadership.

* Implement appropriate HR strategies and actions to recruit, retain, develop, and motivate a qualified and high-performing engineering workforce.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE:**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is a plus but not required.

Typically requires **9 years** of engineering experience, including experience leading or supervising engineering personnel. Experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing and SMT processes is strongly preferred.

 

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrated functional, technical, and people-management skills, with the ability to lead engineers and technicians in a manufacturing environment.

* Strong knowledge of SMT manufacturing processes, including solder paste printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and related manufacturing processes.

* Demonstrated understanding of process capability, statistical process control, root-cause analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plans, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, NPI, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functions.

* Ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, manage competing projects, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to use manufacturing and engineering data to identify problems, establish facts, determine root causes, and drive measurable improvements.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost reduction, capacity, throughput, capital investment, and return on investment.

* Demonstrated ability to develop, coach, and retain engineering talent and build a high-performing team.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

* Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to engineers, technicians, operations personnel, customers, and senior management.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical, engineering, financial, and business documents.

* Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and complaints and resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate communication.

* Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations regarding technical recommendations, business cases, project status, and complex engineering issues.

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, process capability, and statistical analysis and apply them to practical manufacturing situations.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and develop practical solutions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with common engineering and business software, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, data analysis, and other applicable manufacturing/engineering systems.

* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, company policies, and HR practices.

 

JT05

AA01

LB34

 
 

**What you'll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans
* Life Insurance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
* Matching 401(k) Contributions
* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement

records.title: Senior Manager of Production
records.description:
Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical information conveyed to employer.

*Equal Opportunity Employer:* 
*Gwynedd Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*Note: This job description reflects general duties and responsibilities and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Management may modify or assign other responsibilities as needed.*

records.title: Chief of Staff and Strategic Operations
records.description:
**Position Summary**

LTI, a family-owned manufacturer of premium commercial foodservice equipment, is seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations leader to partner directly with the CEO and executive leadership team in driving organizational performance, strategic initiatives, and operational excellence.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor, strategic business partner, and execution leader responsible for translating company priorities into measurable results. The position will work across all functional areas to strengthen communication, improve business processes, accelerate decision-making, and ensure critical initiatives are completed on time and achieve their intended outcomes.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on impact player who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, demonstrates exceptional business judgment, takes ownership of results, and holds themselves and others accountable. This individual must balance strategic thinking with tactical execution and possess the leadership maturity to influence executives without relying on direct reporting authority.

As LTI continues to grow, this position will play an important role in scaling the organization, strengthening leadership effectiveness, and building the operational discipline necessary for long-term success.

**Major Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Planning and Execution**

* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team to develop, prioritize, and execute company-wide strategic objectives.
* Translate long-term business strategies into actionable plans with clearly defined milestones, responsibilities, deadlines, and performance measures.
* Lead and coordinate high-priority strategic initiatives that span multiple departments.
* Monitor progress against strategic objectives, identify obstacles, and drive corrective actions to ensure timely completion.
* Provide the CEO with objective assessments of organizational performance, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure strategic initiatives remain aligned with company growth objectives, financial expectations, and organizational capabilities.

**2. Executive Leadership Support and Organizational Alignment**

* Serve as a strategic advisor and trusted business partner to the CEO.
* Function as a force multiplier by improving the effectiveness, focus, and execution capabilities of the executive leadership team.
* Coordinate cross-functional priorities involving Manufacturing, Engineering & Customer Support, Finance, Human Resources, and Business Development & Marketing.
* Facilitate executive leadership meetings, strategic planning sessions, and performance reviews to drive decisions and measurable outcomes.
* Establish clear accountability for decisions, action items, and commitments made by executive leadership.
* Identify organizational barriers, competing priorities, and communication gaps that negatively impact performance.
* Support the CEO in evaluating organizational effectiveness, leadership capacity, and future business needs.

**3. Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate company-wide business processes, workflows, and operating practices to identify opportunities for greater efficiency and effectiveness.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement improvements that enhance productivity, quality, customer satisfaction, profitability, and organizational responsiveness.
* Lead cross-functional problem-solving efforts involving complex operational and business challenges.
* Promote disciplined execution, process standardization, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and coordinate resources to resolve issues that impact company performance.
* Support initiatives that improve the scalability of manufacturing operations and supporting business functions.
* Ensuring improvement initiatives produce measurable business results rather than simply generating additional activities or reporting.

**4. Performance Management and Accountability**

* Develop and maintain executive-level scorecards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and strategic initiative tracking systems.
* Establish consistent processes for monitoring progress toward company objectives and departmental commitments.
* Work with executive leaders to identify performance gaps and develop appropriate corrective action plans.
* Provide the CEO and leadership team with timely, accurate, and actionable information to support decision-making.
* Establish disciplined follow-up processes to ensure projects, initiatives, and executive commitments are completed within established deadlines.
* Promote a results-oriented culture that emphasizes ownership, urgency, transparency, and accountability.

**5. Strategic Projects and Change Management**

* Assume direct leadership of high-impact projects assigned by the CEO that require coordination across multiple functions.
* Develop project plans, define deliverables, establish timelines, and coordinate resources necessary for successful execution.
* Lead organizational change initiatives associated with business growth, process improvements, technology implementation, and operational transformation.
* Evaluate project risks, resolve implementation challenges, and communicate progress to executive leadership.
* Manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and consistently meeting deadlines.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new business systems, technologies, and organizational capabilities.
* Ensure completed projects are successfully transitioned to the appropriate functional leaders for ongoing ownership.

**6. Financial and Business Performance**

* Partner with the CFO and functional executives to understand financial performance, operating results, and business trends.
* Support initiatives designed to improve profitability, productivity, cost management, and return on investment.
* Assist in evaluating business cases, capital investments, resource allocation, and strategic growth opportunities.
* Ensure major strategic initiatives include appropriate financial objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Monitor performance against established financial and operational targets and help coordinate corrective actions when necessary.
* Maintain a company-wide perspective when evaluating decisions and recommending business priorities.

**7. Leadership Development and Organizational Effectiveness**

* Support the CEO in strengthening executive leadership effectiveness, collaboration, and organizational accountability.
* Identify opportunities to improve leadership processes, decision-making practices, and communication across departments.
* Partner with Human Resources and executive leadership to support succession planning, leadership development, and organizational readiness for growth.
* Encourage a culture of constructive debate, timely decisions, and consistent execution.
* Serve as a positive role model for LTI's core values of **Humble, Hungry, and Smart**.
* Build trust and credibility at all organizational levels, including executive leadership, office personnel, and manufacturing employees.
* Help preserve LTI's family-oriented culture while introducing the structure and discipline necessary to support continued growth.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline required; MBA or advanced business degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive business leadership experience, including significant responsibility for operations, strategic planning, organizational performance, or cross-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with CEOs, presidents, business owners, or senior executive leadership teams.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial products, or a similarly complex operational environment strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of leading strategic initiatives, managing complex projects, and delivering measurable business improvements.
* Experience in a growing, privately held, or family-owned business environment preferred.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial statements, business performance metrics, budgeting, and operational profitability.
* Experience implementing performance management systems, operational improvements, or organizational change initiatives.

**Leadership and Professional Competencies**

* **Strategic and Analytical Thinking:** Ability to understand the broader business environment, evaluate complex issues, and translate strategy into actionable priorities.
* **Execution and Results Orientation:** Strong sense of urgency, personal accountability, and demonstrated ability to deliver results within demanding deadlines.
* **Executive Presence and Influence:** Ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* **Business and Financial Acumen:** Strong understanding of how operational decisions affect financial performance, customer satisfaction, and long-term business success.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Ability to coordinate multiple departments, build alignment, resolve conflicts, and drive shared objectives.
* **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:** Ability to quickly assess challenges, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions.
* **Project and Priority Management:** Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively from the production floor to the executive office.
* **Adaptability and Resilience:** Comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where business priorities and demands may change.
* **Integrity and Confidentiality:** Demonstrated sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive business and personnel information.

**Personal Attributes and Cultural Fit**

The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following characteristics:

* A highly motivated self-starter who takes initiative and requires minimal supervision.
* An impact player who is energized by challenging assignments and opportunities to make a measurable difference.
* A strong work ethic with a willingness to roll up their sleeves and personally drive execution.
* A collaborative leader who values team success over individual recognition.
* A confident but humble professional who can respectfully challenge ideas and accept constructive feedback.
* A proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues rather than waiting for direction.
* A disciplined leader who establishes priorities, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets deadlines.
* A relationship builder who earns trust through credibility, transparency, and demonstrated results.
* A leader who embraces the values and personal accountability expected within a family-owned business.

**Organizational Authority and Scope**

The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will report directly to the CEO and work collaboratively with all members of the executive leadership team.

The position will initially operate primarily through cross-functional leadership, executive influence, and authority delegated by the CEO rather than through direct supervision of existing functional departments.

Functional executives will retain accountability for their respective departments, while the Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will help coordinate company-wide initiatives, facilitate decision-making, and ensure execution of strategic priorities.

The position may assume additional operational responsibilities and direct reports as the organization grows and business needs evolve.

**Measures of Success**

Success in this position will be evaluated through demonstrated improvements in:

* Timely completion of strategic initiatives and executive priorities.
* Organizational alignment and accountability across functional departments.
* Operational efficiency, productivity, and business process effectiveness.
* Achievement of established company-wide performance objectives.
* Executive leadership effectiveness and decision-making.
* Successful implementation of high-impact business projects.
* Financial and operational improvements resulting from strategic initiatives.
* Organizational readiness to support continued growth.

**Overall Expectation:** The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations must consistently demonstrate an ability to convert business priorities into completed actions, measurable improvements, and sustainable organizational results.

records.title: Director, Operations
records.description:
Overview:

Resonetics is a global leader in advanced engineering, prototyping, product development, and micro manufacturing, driving innovation in the medical device industry. With rapid expansion across all our locations, we continue to push the boundaries of technology while fostering a dynamic, employee-centered culture. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement makes Resonetics an exciting place for professionals passionate about shaping the future of micro-manufacturing and being part of something bigger.

The Director of Operations is responsible for overseeing daily production activities to drive efficiency, maintain quality, and ensure adherence to company standards. This role leads the development and implementation of organizational strategies, standards, and best practices to achieve world-class operational performance. Additionally, the Director of Production collaborates closely with site and business leadership, leveraging resources and expertise to ensure our products consistently meet customer expectations.

Join Resonetics and be part of a team that’s redefining medical device manufacturing. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

* Lead with a clear view of where the organization needs to be in 1-3 years; communicates strategic direction to employees and how it fits with the day-to-day actions and results being driven.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Implement and maintain value streams and SCQDCT management system within the site.
* Provide coaching and support to supervisors and frontline employees to enhance skills and performance.
* Set clear and measureable performance expectations, in line with corporate goals; proactively analyze and manage all relative operations performance metrics.
* Provide timely, accurate and complete reports on the operating conditions of the company.Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensures alignment with functional leadership (e.g., Engineering, Finance, Quality, Facilities, and Human Resources) on performance management and talent development.
* Ensure the facilities operate within the Company’s ISO and FDA quality management system.
* Participate in the development of the location’s monthly revenue forecasts.
* Monitor and adjust production output and staff levels to support the location’s revenue and cost targets.
* Participate in the development and control of the location’s budgets and quarterly forecasts.
* Working with the senior leadership team, help to develop and implement winning strategies to grow revenues and profitability.
* Ensure the site maintains maximum confidentiality in a highly proprietary operationLead relationship with key intercompany customers to ensure maximum service throughout the value chain.

Required Qualifications:

* BS degree in a technical field, preferably engineering or life sciences.
* Prior experience managing a manufacturing department/organization in a regulated environment.
* Prior experience managing an engineering team.
* Experience working within a Lean, six-sigma organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Prior experience managing an independent manufacturing organization.
* Familiarity with contract manufacturing, ISO and FDA quality system requirements, medical device and diagnostics manufacturing.
* Lean, six-sigma green or black belt certified.
* Experience with Nitinol products and processing
* Experience wit Wire and Tube fabrication
* MBA or relevant business management experience.

Physical Demands:

* Ability to work long hours when necessary and to have a presence with a 24/7 operation.
* Domestic travel required

Compensation:

* The compensation for this role is competitive and will be based on experience and qualifications. The anticipated range is $144,000–$204,000.
* Our company policy is that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must already be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

Resonetics offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; paid time off (PTO); 10 paid holidays; Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA); life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance; Short-Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD) insurance; accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance. Eligibility and benefit offerings may vary based on employment status and applicable plan provisions.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
We are seeking a skilled Plant Manager to oversee our co-manufacturing operations. The Plant Manager will be responsible for managing all aspects of plant operations while ensuring efficient production processes and maintaining high standards of quality and safety. This role requires strong leadership abilities, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of manufacturing operations in a co-manufacturing setting.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Operational Leadership: Lead day-to-day plant operations, including production, packaging, maintenance, and quality control, to achieve production targets and quality standards.
* Team Management: Supervise and mentor a team of managers, supervisors, technicians, and support staff, fostering a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Production Planning: Develop and implement production schedules and resource allocation plans to optimize efficiency and meet customer demand while minimizing costs.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure adherence to quality assurance protocols and regulatory requirements, implementing corrective actions as needed to address non-conformities and improve processes.
* Safety and Compliance: Maintain a safe working environment by enforcing safety policies and procedures, conducting regular safety audits, and promoting a culture of safety awareness among employees.
* Budget and Cost Control: Manage plant budget and expenses effectively, identifying opportunities for cost savings and implementing measures to improve operational efficiency.
* Supplier and Customer Relations: Collaborate with suppliers and co-manufacturing partners to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods, and build strong relationships with customers to understand their needs and preferences.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, such as Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies, to streamline processes, reduce waste, and enhance overall plant performance.
* Reporting and Analysis: Prepare regular reports on plant performance, including production metrics, quality metrics, and financial KPIs, and provide analysis and recommendations for improvement to senior management.

**Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Proven experience (10+ years) in a managerial role within a co-manufacturing or food production environment.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and develop a diverse team.
* Strategic thinker with a track record of driving operational excellence and achieving business objectives.
* Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite; experience with manufacturing software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on data-driven decision-making.
* Certification in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other relevant certifications is desirable.
* #LI-JO1

Maker's Pride is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

records.title: Director, Program Operations
records.description:
In this role, the Director of Program Operations leads a team of Operations Program Managers (OPM) and Material Program Managers (MPM) responsible for the operational elements of program execution within Mercury's Processing Technologies business unit. This role serves as the primary conduit between the line of business and operational teams, ensuring seamless coordination across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and growth functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing operational program plans for critical programs, overall ownership of operational program performance, and internal communication of customer requirements affecting operational execution.

The Director of Program Operations will support proposals by providing accurate basis of cost estimates, focusing on supply chain material costs in addition to manufacturing labor costs. This work will be performed in conjunction with factory operations, supply chain, and engineering functions. Candidates must have excellent written and oral communications skills to influence across multiple functions and communicate effectively with external partners.

This role is on site at one of the following Mercury facilities: **Hudson NH, Phoenix AZ**

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of OPMs and MPMs accountable for operational aspects of program life cycle from proposal, development, production, sustainment, & delivery.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the line of business and operations, communicating customer requirements that affect manufacturing and supply chain execution.
* Responsible for meeting the financial objectives of the business unit, including the management of Estimate at Completion (EACs) specific to operations labor and material content.
* Oversee supply chain and manufacturing milestones to ensure compliance with contract baseline.
* Monitor program risks and opportunities, including obsolescence management, reporting, and improvement actions.
* Support and present operations metrics and data through program reviews (both internal and external) to Mercury and customer leadership.
* Champion efforts to meet readiness requirements throughout an NPI stage-gate process.
* Change leader, helping to drive Mercury's strategy, structure, and values.
* Strategic thinking coupled with ROI / business case development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Typically requires 10+ years prior relevant experience in functional areas of Supply Chain, Operations (including Production Control), Program Management, or technical Project Management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience providing input into and reviewing EACs, along with development of business cases.
* Experience in review and understanding of Statements of Work (SOW) and project requirements (technical and commercial).
* Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
* Experience developing and mentoring high‑performing teams.
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), leadership abilities, and the ability to work in an IPT environment.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A self-starter, capable of achieving organizational and program objectives, and able to interface with all levels of internal management and external stakeholders.
* Ability to succeed in fast paced, developmental environment.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to assign the appropriate priorities to the many tasks that need to be performed.
* Knowledge of US Government acquisition laws and regulations (FAR).
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP business systems.
* Knowledge of Mercury-type products.

#LI-RL1

Mercury Systems is a technology company that makes the world a safer, more secure place. We push processing power to the tactical edge, making the latest commercial technologies profoundly more accessible for today's most challenging aerospace and defense missions. From silicon to system scale, Mercury enables customers to accelerate innovation and turn data into decision superiority. Headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, Mercury employs more than 2,300 people in 24 locations worldwide. To learn more, visit mrcy.com

We are committed to making Mercury a great place to work, no matter where our employees are located. We offer a casual and enjoyable atmosphere that allows employees to learn and grow. We help and care for one another and work as one to achieve results for us and for our customers. records.title: Senior Manager, Quality, Fauna
records.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization supporting our robots from development through production. 
In this role, you will improve product and manufacturing quality while building the testing capabilities needed to scale. Your organization will support new product introduction through volume production across our facilities, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
You will build the team and its engineering leadership, set the technical direction, and establish quality standards and validation processes. You will turn changing product and manufacturing needs into a roadmap that supports higher production volumes and additional sites. 
The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who has improved quality and reliability for products where hardware and software must work together. They can evaluate test strategies and guide critical supplier, production, and reliability investigations. They grow engineers and leaders, and make clear decisions on scope and priority while product designs and manufacturing processes are changing. 
 
Key job responsibilities 

* Architect the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization. Assess capability gaps, define the staffing and investment plan, and hire and develop the engineering leaders and teams needed to scale.
* Establish supplier and factory quality teams, with Fauna engineers embedded at manufacturing sites. Strengthen and scale the quality system to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Define and lead the reliability strategy, working with our engineers to improve robot performance and durability.
* Build and scale reliability labs and test infrastructure to support product development and production growth.
* Scale and develop the manufacturing test engineering team, shaping its structure, growing its leaders, and strengthening its capabilities to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Deploy and qualify production test systems across our facilities and manufacturing partners. Partner with the software and systems team on automation and traceable results, and improve repeatability, cycle time, and failure diagnosis.
* Partner with engineering and operations to embed quality, reliability, and testability into product design and production readiness.
* Establish quality and reliability metrics and use production, test, and field data to guide priorities and drive sustained improvement.

 
About the team 
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
 
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
 
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
 
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
 
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 10+ years in quality, test engineering, or reliability for complex electromechanical products.
* 5+ years managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, with a track record of building organizations and developing engineers and leaders.
* Experience scaling supplier and manufacturing quality through NPI and production ramp, with strong knowledge of quality systems.
* Technical depth in reliability and manufacturing test engineering, with experience scaling test programs and infrastructure for integrated hardware-software products.
* Strong command of statistical analysis and structured problem-solving, with demonstrated success turning engineering data into product and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with robotics or autonomous systems.
* Experience leading engineering managers or distributed teams across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers globally
* Experience with product safety certification or formal quality management standards.

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

records.description:
Keys Dental Specialists in Key West, FL, is looking for a **full-time Director of Dental Operations** to join our growing team. We offer **competitive pay**, opportunities for professional growth, and a supportive dentistry team culture that values collaboration and new ideas.

We also offer **generous benefits**, such as:

* Dental benefits
* 6 paid holidays
* Flexible scheduling
* PTO
* Leadership and personal development trainings
* A great atmosphere

This is a **full-time position** with a set schedule. If this sounds like the right fit for you, keep reading about this Director of Dental Operations position!

**WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT OUR FAMILY-ORIENTED BUSINESS?**

We are a team of highly qualified dentists and specialists who work together to expertly address each of our patients' dental and sedation needs. Our doctors focus their expertise and training on patients who seek only the best in general dentistry and oral surgery. We manage a wide variety of problems relating to the mouth, jaws, and facial region, including bone grafting, wisdom teeth extraction, dental implant surgery, corrective jaw surgery, and traumatic injuries. Our approach to quality dentistry is to customize our care and help our patients meet their goals as we strive to attain total patient satisfaction.

Our staff has been called "caring" in our reviews, which underscores how essential our employees are to our success. To show them how much **we appreciate them and value their contributions**, we provide **flexible scheduling** and offer **highly competitive wages**. We also cultivate a **warm and welcoming atmosphere** that benefits both our patients and our staff. Many people comment that they feel "comfortable" with us, which lets us know we're succeeding at helping **everyone who enters our doors feel at home**.

**DO YOU MEET THESE QUALIFICATIONS?**

* Experience in the dental field with a strong understanding of workflow optimization
* Proactive approach to problem-solving and getting things done
* Ability to guide teams and manage multiple projects effectively
* Comfort in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment
* Problem-solving mindset with a focus on long-term success
* Commitment to enhancing patient care and experiences
* Strong communication skills and a transparent, team-oriented approach
* Passion for continuous learning and leveraging the latest dental technology

**WHAT WILL YOU DO AS A DIRECTOR OF DENTAL OPERATIONS?**

As a Director of Dental Operations, you will play a key role in driving initiatives that support the growth and efficiency of our practice. You will work closely with leadership to turn ideas into action, ensuring that processes run smoothly and effectively. Your day will involve streamlining operations, managing multiple projects, and guiding team members to maintain high standards of care and efficiency. You will thrive in a fast-moving environment where problem-solving and adaptability are essential. From optimizing workflows to implementing innovative solutions, you will make a meaningful impact on both our team and the patients we serve.

**READY TO APPLY AND ADVANCE YOUR CAREER?**

If you are excited about this dentistry opportunity and want to be part of a growing dentistry, we'd love to hear from you! Apply today with our 3-minute, mobile-friendly initial application and take the next step in your career!
