records.description:
**What makes DHL great?** Our People! We know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 Express Delivery and Logistics Company in the world.

***Distinguished as No. 1 World’s Best Workplace™ by Great Place to Work and Fortune Magazine***

DHL Express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. Our culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. DHL is dedicated to being a great place to work. In addition to competitive compensation packages, our employees enjoy a range of programs, services and benefits that bring the best to their personal lives.

**Start YOUR career with DHL today…**

The **Sr. Director Operations** is responsible for providing strategic input and leading the implementation of the Courier and Pick-up & Delivery strategy. This role ensures the safe, secure, timely, and accurate transportation and delivery of mail, parcels, small packages, and legal documents between locations, in alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, corporate guidelines, and policies.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Provide input to develop Couriers, Pick-up & Delivery operations strategy to deliver effective collection, transportation, and delivery of parcels while maintaining exceptional service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Plan, organize and control preparation of annual business plans, operational budgets, workforce planning, and resource allocation for delivery operations.
* Provide expertise, coaching, and leadership to frontline managers and supervisors to ensure execution of daily operational activities, achievement of performance targets, and development of future leaders.
* Manage and control service point operations to enable efficient collection, handling, and distribution of shipments while maintaining compliance with operational standards.
* Manage and control scheduling of transportation capacity, traffic volumes, route structures, and delivery resources to maximize productivity and service performance.
* Lead a workforce of more than 1,000 employees across multiple facilities, fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, safety, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge and experience operating in unionized environments, including labor relations, contract interpretation, grievance resolution, workforce planning, and effective collaboration with union leadership.
* Oversee large independent contractor (IC) networks and transportation providers, ensuring contractual compliance, operational performance, cost management, and service reliability.
* Drive operational expense (OPEX) management through disciplined financial oversight, productivity initiatives, route optimization, and continuous improvement programs to achieve profitability objectives.
* Partner closely with Network Operations, Gateway Operations, Brokerage, Customs, Aviation, and Commercial teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments and network requirements.
* Deploy structured approaches to manage operational procedures including shipment processing, sorting, loading/unloading, documentation, scanning compliance, manifests, secure handling, and custody control.
* Implement reporting standards, performance metrics, and operational dashboards to provide visibility into service performance, cost drivers, productivity, and customer experience measures.
* Anticipate changes in customer demand, economic conditions, labor markets, and transportation trends to proactively adjust operational strategies and resource requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation, delivery, and customer service solutions through process redesign, technology implementation, and network optimization.
* Monitor operational performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, productivity, safety, employee engagement, and cost control.
* Lead multiple delivery bases and service centers across geographically diverse markets, ensuring consistent execution of operational standards and business objectives.
* Champion safety, security, and compliance programs while maintaining adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Build strong relationships with key customers, local business leaders, and internal stakeholders to support growth initiatives and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Drive organizational change initiatives, workforce transformation efforts, and strategic projects across the region while maintaining high levels of employee engagement and operational performance.

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 8+ years of experience in operations and leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience in budgetary management and financial accountability.
* Strong background in business and operations management, including managing complex operational environments.
* Experience leading courier, Pick-up & Delivery, dock, and transportation operations.
* Proven ability to lead change management and operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven leadership experience managing a department or business unit comprising multiple teams, including Managers and/or Team Leaders.
* Strong ability to lead, develop, and influence leaders and teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Experience establishing priorities, managing resources, and driving performance across multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated ability to drive employee engagement, foster an inclusive and high-performing culture, and develop strategies that strengthen employee experience, retention, and organizational effectiveness.

**Employee Benefits & Incentives**

DHL Express benefits and incentive offerings are designed to reflect a substantial experience for both employees and their dependents during their career and life journey. The specifics will vary, but wherever you join and in whatever role, you'll find our benefits and rewards are among the best in the industry They include:

* Competitive Pay - Salary Range New Jersey $187,950- $250,600
* Bonus/Incentive Programs
* Retirement Savings – 401K with company match
* Medical, Dental, Vision, well-being programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Generous Paid Time Off – Starting at 4 Weeks (PT/FT)
* Paid Leave
* Employee Discount Program
* Employee Assistance & Work Life Program
* Outstanding training opportunities

We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status,* *or any other protected characteristic. The EEO is the Law poster is available here:* *https://www.eeoc.gov/employers/eeo-law-poster*

*We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to* *participate* *in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.* *Please contact us to request accommodation.*

Director of Operations – DC Restaurant Group

**DC Restaurant Group | Virginia & North Carolina**

**Salary: $150,000–$175,000 Annually**

About the Opportunity

DC Restaurant Group is seeking an experienced and results-driven **Director of Operations** to oversee daily operations across a large restaurant group with multiple locations throughout Virginia and North Carolina.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strong restaurant operations leader who is passionate about developing teams, improving restaurant performance, and driving operational excellence across multiple markets.

The Director of Operations will report directly to the Vice President of Operations and work closely with District Managers to ensure restaurants are operating efficiently, meeting company standards, and achieving financial and operational goals.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee daily operations across a large portfolio of restaurant locations, ensuring consistency and strong operational performance.
* Lead, coach, and develop District Managers to drive accountability, leadership development, and restaurant success.
* Partner with the Vice President of Operations to execute company strategies, initiatives, and operational goals.
* Monitor restaurant performance, including sales, profitability, labor costs, food costs, and overall P&L results.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits to evaluate operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and support District Managers.
* Ensure restaurants consistently meet company standards for food safety, cleanliness, customer service, and operational efficiency.
* Develop action plans to address performance challenges and improve restaurant results.
* Support recruitment, training, and development of restaurant leadership teams.
* Work closely with District Managers to improve employee retention, guest satisfaction, and overall restaurant performance.
* Provide regular updates to the Vice President of Operations regarding market performance, operational challenges, and opportunities for growth.

Qualifications

* 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in multi-unit restaurant operations.
* Previous experience as a Director of Operations, Regional Director, or senior multi-unit restaurant leader.
* Strong background in quick-service restaurants (QSR), preferably within a franchise or large multi-unit restaurant organization.
* Proven experience leading and developing District Managers across multiple restaurant locations.
* Strong understanding of restaurant financials, P&L management, budgeting, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability, operational standards, and team performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout Virginia and North Carolina to support restaurant operations.

Compensation

**$150,000–$175,000 annually**, depending on experience.

**Apply today to join DC Restaurant Group and play a key role in the continued growth and success of our restaurant organization!**

Pay: $150,000.00 - $175,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

records.title: 7 Brew Director of Operations
records.description:
Description:

**Why 7 Brew? Because We Invest in YOU!**

At 7 Brew, it’s more than coffee—it’s about brewing smiles one cup at a time. We’re built on kindness, connection, and community, and every guest interaction is an opportunity to make someone’s day brighter.

Brewtopia, a passionate franchise group, is proud to bring the bold energy of 7 Brew to Southeast Michigan. With proven success in quick-service restaurants, we’re dedicated to operational excellence, people-first leadership, and a high-energy drive-thru experience that stands out.

We’re looking for a high-energy, people-first Director of Operations to lead our drive-thru coffee operations. This is a unique opportunity to shape the culture, systems, and guest experience from the ground up—and to grow with us as we expand.

**OUR VALUES**

* Strive for Excellence – We raise the bar every day.
* Elevate Others – We build people up.
* Results Driven – We focus on impact.
* Visionary – We dream big and lead with purpose.
* Exceed Expectations – We go beyond what’s expected.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Competitive Salary:** $125,000 base per year
* **Performance Bonus:** 15% target, tied to KPIs and company performance
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health insurance, 401K with competitive match, generous PTO
* **Car Allowance:** Up to $500 /month
* **Cellphone Stipend:** Up to $25 a pay
* **Growth & Learning:** Clear development plans and a culture of continuous improvement
* **More Than Coffee:** Infused energy drinks, Italian sodas, smoothies, teas, and more!

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The Director of Operations ensures consistency, quality, and efficiency across all locations—protecting the brand and growing guest loyalty. This role optimizes profitability, develops strong leaders, and executes strategic growth initiatives with relentless focus on the guest.

* **Operations & Guest Experience:** Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple drive-thru shops, ensuring speed of service, drink quality, food safety, cleanliness, and brand consistency.
* **Team Leadership & Development:** Lead, mentor, and develop Regional Leaders and General Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, recognition, and continuous growth.
* **Financial Management & Strategic Growth:** Own the P&L, manage labor and COGS, drive sales and flow-through, and collaborate with leadership to execute growth strategies and support new shop openings.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Drive Growth & Profitability:** Regularly review and adjust the budget and financial reports to ensure cost goals are met. Implement strategies to optimize labor, track performance against financial goals, and ensure key profit-driving actions are executed in a timely manner.
* **Ensure Operational Excellence:** Conduct daily operational reviews to ensure adherence to brand standards. Regularly assess performance metrics, respond to customer feedback, and implement action plans to improve service quality.
* **Lead & Develop Teams:** Hold weekly one-on-one coaching sessions with Regional Managers, ensuring consistent training and development. Work with HR and other departments to fill staffing gaps quickly and develop training programs that align with business needs.
* **Foster Guest Satisfaction & Compliance:** Address and resolve guest concerns within 24 hours, ensuring that guest satisfaction is prioritized.
* **Collaborate & Align:** Actively participate in weekly leadership meetings, contribute to discussions, and align team goals with corporate objectives. Share progress updates and ensure all team members are informed and working toward shared priorities.
* **Culture Keeper:** Foster a recognition culture, coach privately and praise publicly, and promote healthy competition and collaboration across locations.

Requirements:

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Leadership & Team Management:** Proven ability to build, coach, and scale high-performing multi-unit teams
* **Financial Acumen:** Budgeting, P&L ownership, labor modeling, KPI-driven decisions
* **Operational Excellence:** Multi-unit drive-thru/QSR expertise with a bias for speed, quality, and safety
* **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:** Data-driven, resourceful, and decisive in a fast-paced environment
* **Communication:** Clear, candid communicator across shop, field, and corporate partners
* **Customer Focus:** Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences consistently
* **Strategic Planning & Execution:** Translate goals into disciplined, scalable routines
* **Compliance & Safety:** Knowledge of health, safety, and regulatory standards
* **Technology Proficiency:** POS/back-office, labor scheduling, spreadsheets/dashboards

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Multi-unit leadership in QSR/coffee/drive-thru; ideally **2+ years in a director-level role**
* Bachelor's in business management, Hospitality, or related field is a plus

**PHYSICAL AND TIME REQUIREMENTS**

* **General Mobility:** Sit, stand, bend, and move for extended periods during meetings, presentations, or line work
* **Manual Dexterity:** Proficiency in typing and using office equipment such as computers, printers, and phones
* **Visual and Auditory Acuity:** Ability to read printed and digital documents; clear hearing for communication
* **Lifting and Carrying:** Ability to lift and carry items weighing up to 50 pounds
* **Travel:** Frequent travel to multiple locations (>75%)

**TIME REQUIREMENT**

* Availability to primarily work during areas of business growth, including nights and weekends.

**Ready to bring the brew and bring your best?**

Join the Brewtopia movement today! If you’re ready for an epic, energetic, and rewarding journey, we’d love to have you on the crew. But first – let’s get to know you better! Start your journey with us by completing a quick **5-7 minute Culture Index survey**. It's a key part of the process, and we promise – it’s quick, easy, and essential!

Survey Link: https://surveys.cultureindex.com/s/y8HlLcvMA4/93831

**Disclaimer**

This job description outlines the general responsibilities and expectations of the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, or requirements.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered fairly and without discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status. Hiring decisions are made solely on job-related qualifications and business needs.

records.title: Director, Operational Excellence
records.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence will focus on delivery excellence, process optimization, resource management, and stakeholder management. The Director will be an operational leader who develops frameworks and effective ways of working on which our organization can build in the coming years. This includes ownership of organizational resource tracking, resource planning, hiring process support, and staff augmentation vendor management, so the organization has the right talent in the right roles at the right time in line with funds planning. The Director and team will ensure that the organization develops and fully integrates a continuous improvement culture, with the ultimate goal of ensuring team efficiency, and financial effectiveness.

 

* Leads priorities focused on service delivery and capability alignment, resource management, budget/financial management, vendor and technology management, communications, and training
* Partners with the Leadership Team in short- and long-term planning activities that align with the organization’s strategy, vision, operational plan, and goals
* Establishes and maintains organization-wide resource tracking, providing visibility into headcount, allocation, capacity, utilization, and cost across colleagues and contingent workers
* Leads resource planning in partnership with the Leadership Team and Finance, forecasting demand, identifying capability and capacity gaps, and recommending the right mix of full-time and augmented staff
* Supports hiring processes in partnership with Talent Acquisition and PX, including position requests and approvals, job description development, requisition tracking, interview coordination, and onboarding readiness
* Manages processes related to staff augmentation vendors, including vendor selection, rate and contract negotiation, performance management, and spend oversight
* Drives innovative thinking and planning, leveraging new technologies as needed, to address the needs of the organization and its individual capabilities
* Challenges the status quo and drives continuous improvement by establishing a solid foundation and implementing standard ways of working, systems, processes, and frameworks.
* Works closely with cross-functional peers and team members to consolidate efforts for org processes improvements, but also applies independent decision making to ensure best possible approach is being implemented.
* Promotes a continuous improvement mindset and process improvement initiatives through communication, training, and best practices, ensuring accountability through governance.
* Has critical impact on significant reduction of administrative and redundant tasks across Engineering & Technology organization through applying most efficient and suitable AI tools and bringing in innovative ways of working.
* Builds, develops, and grows relationships with internal and external stakeholders and vendors at every level
* Serves as strategic program/project manager for key organizational projects. Has direct accountability for budget assigned to these projects and management of related vendors, supports oversight processes for organizational budget.
* Coaches, mentors, and supports the professional growth of direct reports. Responsible for efficient resource and funds allocation within the team.

**Basic Qualifications**

Bachelors degree and 8+ years relevant work experience

Strong written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal, collaboration, and facilitation skills

Proven analytical and critical thinking skills, and strong background in process improvement

Practical experience with operational, process improvement, gaining efficiencies and project management methodologies and ability to lead project teams

Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines

Strong ability for independent decision making while working closely with cross-functional peers

Demonstrated ability to manage/lead complex projects, including resource and budget management for assigned projects

**Preferred Qualifications**

Masters degree in related field

Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industry experience

Practical experience with organization setup processes that include job descriptions creation, managing hiring processes with human resources, sourcing contracted resources.

Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB)

Knowledge of or expertise in Digital product development and/or Design Thinking

Experience driving change in a global, matrixed organization

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

National and International travel may be necessary

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Last Date to Apply for Job: 11/30/2026

 
The annual base salary for this position ranges from $176,600.00 to $294,300.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. 
This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.

Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

**Sunshine Act**

Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative.

**EEO & Employment Eligibility**

Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States.

Pfizer endeavors to make www.pfizer.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. This is to be used solely for accommodation requests with respect to the accessibility of our website, online application process and/or interviewing. Requests for any other reason will not be returned.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing
records.description:
We are seeking a strategic, technical, and results-driven Director of Manufacturing to lead and optimize high-volume packaging blow molding facility. As a key member of the executive leadership team, you will bridge organizational strategy with daily shop floor execution by overseeing multi-shift operations, managing the operational budget, and driving performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and talent development. To succeed in this role, you will bring deep technical expertise in plastic blow molding technologies, automated downstream packaging, and strong financial acumen to achieve large-scale operational excellence.
  
  
In terms of strategic leadership and daily operations, you will execute manufacturing strategies that maximize throughput, cycle times, and capacity utilization across all production lines. You will oversee multi-shift operations to foster a culture of accountability and high performance on the plant floor while maintaining disciplined daily management routines, including production reviews, KPI tracking, and systematic escalation procedures. Additionally, you will translate forecasting and demand data into actionable manufacturing plans, master schedules, and staffing models designed to meet fast-paced consumer goods delivery timelines.
  
  
From a technical and equipment management perspective, you will optimize processing parameters across a diverse fleet of plastic blow molding machinery and drive high-speed automation projects. You will also oversee material management to maximize the efficiency of high-volume grades. Partner closely with Maintenance and Tooling teams to minimize changeover downtime, and enforce rigorous preventive maintenance programs.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing - Big Beverages
records.description:
If you're reading this on your way from 5am spin class to festival fast-pass, you're CELSIUS®— an everyday hustler with the essential energy to aim high, and go the extra mile wherever your goals take you.

Joyful by design, sunny by nature, and unapologetically bold. If your bestie has you saved in their phone as "Icon," you're ALANI NU® — confident, colorful, and bringing main-character energy to every moment.

SoCal in your soul, attitude in your stride. If gravity doesn't stop you and "impossible" sounds more like "dare you," you're ROCKSTAR®— a born rebel, raising the bar with mind-body energy and zero compromise.

---

Together, we're Celsius Holdings, Inc.— a global CPG company united by three powerhouse brands and one incredibly talented team.

At Celsius, we pride ourselves on empowering our people. Every employee has a stake in our success. We create a collaborative culture built on inclusivity, innovation, and a belief that great ideas can come from anywhere.

And we're on our way to building something bigger: a category where energy isn't just consumed, it's lived—where performance meets personality, brand becomes community, and every can crack sparks a statement.

**This is the future of modern energy. This is Celsius.**

Ready to take your career to the next level? Join our team and redefine what it means to be energized.

**Position Overview**

As the Director of Manufacturing, you will serve as the senior plant leader for a high-volume beverage canning operation responsible for batching, filling, seaming, and packaging canned CELSIUS® beverages. You will provide strategic and operational leadership across production, quality, food safety, maintenance, engineering, safety, warehousing, workforce development, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who has operated in a high-speed, automated food, beverage, packaging, or consumer products environment. This role requires strong business judgment, operational discipline, technical understanding, and the ability to build an accountable, collaborative culture focused on safety, food safety, quality, service, cost, and continuous improvement.

**On-Site:**
Based full-time in Charlotte, NC at Big Beverages manufacturing facility

**Travel Requirements:**
Up to 25% domestic travel

**People Management Responsibilities:**
Yes

**Reports To:**
VP of Manufacturing

**Role Type:**
Full-Time

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  7-10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, preferably in high-speed beverage filling/canning, food, or consumer packaged goods operations, including at least 3-5 years leading a plant or multi-department operation with full responsibility for production performance and hourly teams
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Food Science, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered
* Experience leading high-volume, automated manufacturing operations and managing production, maintenance, engineering, quality, safety, and continuous improvement functions
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000, ISO 22000 principles, HACCP, GMP, FSMA, food defense, food fraud prevention, traceability, prerequisite programs, CAPA systems, and audit readiness
* Demonstrated success improving OEE, schedule attainment, throughput, labor efficiency, yield, waste, downtime, quality, cost performance, and equipment reliability through disciplined operating systems
* Experience managing budgets, labor planning, capital projects, business cases, and plant-level financial performance
* Experience hiring, developing, coaching, and leading large hourly and salaried teams, including supervisors and frontline leaders
* Experience using ERP/MRP, MES, maintenance-management, and manufacturing-performance systems to make data-driven decisions
* Strong analytical, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work onsite at the manufacturing facility and support a flexible schedule based on operational needs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Food Science, or a related field
* PCQI, HACCP, FSSC 22000, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certification or training
* Hands-on experience with high-speed carbonated beverage filling and canning lines, including syrup batching/blending, water treatment, carbonation, fillers, can seamers and double-seam integrity, can warmers/pasteurizers, CIP sanitation, and end-of-line packaging and palletizing
* Experience with plant start-ups, expansions, new line installations, automation, commissioning, scale-up, or major capital investments
* Experience supporting a rapidly growing consumer brand or publicly traded company
* Experience working with labor relations or represented manufacturing environments

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all manufacturing operations to ensure the safe, efficient, and consistent production of high-quality canned beverages from production scheduling through finished-goods handoff
* Develop and execute the plant operating strategy in alignment with CELSIUS business objectives, demand forecasts, customer requirements, and long-term growth plans
* Own production planning, capacity, staffing, schedule attainment, changeovers, line utilization, labor efficiency, and daily operating execution
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability across production, quality, food safety, maintenance, engineering, warehouse, and support functions
* Drive key operating metrics, including safety, OEE, throughput, yield, scrap, waste, downtime, labor productivity, cost per unit, on-time production, and schedule attainment
* Establish and sustain leader standard work, tiered accountability, visual management, root-cause problem solving, standard work, and continuous-improvement routines
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering on preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, automation, capital priorities, commissioning, line expansions, and new technology implementation
* Coordinate with Warehousing, Logistics, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Customer Service to maintain material availability, protect product integrity, and ensure accurate and timely finished-goods handoff

records.description:
**Job Description**
**Director, Production Operations in Springfield, MO**
Build your future at Curia, where our work has the power to save lives
  
  
Curia is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with over 30 years of experience partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to provide life-saving treatments to patients. At Curia, we are on a mission to advance our customers’ therapies from curiosity to cure and ultimately to improve patients’ lives.
  
  
We proudly offer
  
  

* Generous benefit options (eligible first day of employment)
* Paid training, vacation and holidays (vacation accrual begins on first day of employment)
* Career advancement opportunities
* Education reimbursement
* 401K program with matching contributions
* Learning platform
* And more!

At Curia, manufacturing excellence is at the heart of everything we do. The Director, Production Operations is a key member of the Springfield leadership team, responsible for managing, planning, directing, and coordinating manufacturing processes across our large scale, pilot plant, and technical services organizations. This leader ensures our operations are safe, compliant, cost-effective, and positioned for growth.
  
  
This is a role for a proven leader who brings both strategic vision and operational discipline. The Director contributes to the development of business and functional strategies, communicates them clearly across the site, and translates them into action. Working cross-functionally with Quality, Regulatory, and other departments, this leader drives high performance in cGMP compliance, schedule adherence, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As much as this role is about operational outcomes, it is also about people. The Director identifies and develops the next generation of leaders within the organization, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration that reflects the Curia Way.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**
**Strategy and Planning**

* Develop and implement short and long range goals and objectives that align with business growth and profitability targets.
* Set strategic leadership goals for key section heads within the large scale, pilot plant, and technical services organizations.
* Review operational plans to assess manufacturing capacity requirements and make recommendations to improve capacity utilization and support business development planning.
* Develop, implement, and maintain Key Performance Indicators and monitoring systems to drive high levels of performance within the department and across the organization.

Operations and Compliance
  
  

* Oversee manufacturing operations to ensure safety, quality, productivity, and efficiency, working collaboratively with the management team to prevent and resolve operational, quality, financial, and facility issues.
* Partner with Quality and Regulatory departments to drive high performance in cGMP compliance and ensure operations meet organizational requirements for quality management, health and safety, legal, and environmental standards.
* Ensure proper planning and effective execution of production activities to minimize downtime and maximize output per the production schedule, working closely with supporting departments to maintain schedule adherence.
* Proactively lead local efforts to prepare for and execute productive customer visits.
* Analyze activities, costs, operations, and forecast data to assess progress toward goals and initiate corrective action as needed to meet business and financial objectives.
* Perform other related duties as may be reasonably assigned in the course of business.

**Good Manufacturing & Documentation Practices**
Quality is something we take pride in together. You’ll perform your work in alignment with cGMP requirements and Curia’s standards to ensure our facilities support the safe and reliable manufacture of products for our customers.
  
  

* Perform all documentation in compliance with ALCOA++ principles and site SOPs.
* Adhere to applicable cGMP documents including SOPs, batch records, protocols, change controls, and controlled forms.
* Keep all required cGMP training current and escalate quality concerns along with proposed solutions to the Quality department.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
* Minimum 5–10 years of mid to senior management experience in a manufacturing or process environment
* Demonstrated understanding of the responsibilities and functions of key departments within a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing facility
* Strong knowledge of cGMP compliance, technical operations, and quality systems within a manufacturing environment
* Proven ability to identify, develop, and inspire leaders at multiple levels of the organization
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present strategy and performance clearly to site and functional leadership

**Preferred**

* Experience with API development and manufacturing processes
* Certification in Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma

**Physical Requirements**
The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.
  
  

* Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, talk, and hear.
* Frequently required to use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, and climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* May occasionally lift and/or move up to 55 pounds.
* Visual requirements include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
The work environment characteristics described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this role.
  
  

* Regular work in a standard office environment, with frequent entry into the production area of a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility.
* Production environment may include moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, extreme heat, wet or humid conditions, low levels of toxic or caustic chemicals, and outdoor weather conditions.
* Noise level in the work environment is typically moderate.

*New York, New York, United States (Hybrid – 3 days/week in office)*
Who We Are
  
  
At Pets + People, we make tails wag and customers smile with products brought to market through strategic licensing and innovation. Our brands make everyday life fresh, fun, and user-friendly for the whole family.

Now, we are leveraging our long track record of success and applying it both to pets + people.” – Steven Shweky, Top Dog
  
  
**About The Role**
Learn more about our capabilities at www.petspeople.com
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking Director of Production to lead and evolve our global production organization within a fast-paced Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) environment. This role is critical in driving operational excellence across both domestic and international production, while also reimagining how production can be more innovative, automated, and scalable as the business grows.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who thrives in complexity, can manage a large SKU portfolio across multiple markets, builds strong global vendor partnerships, and inspires teams through coaching and mentorship. This person will lead on behalf of the department head when needed and serve as a strategic thought partner across the organization. We are open to candidates from a variety of industries, provided they bring transferable production leadership experience and a passion for continuous improvement.

records.description:
Growing manufacturing company in the
**Redmond-Bend, OR**
area is seeking a
**Plant Director**
who will serve as the primary operational leader responsible for total day-to-day manufacturing execution, plant safety, and financial performance across the facility. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this position owns full end-to-end plant operations—driving daily execution across production, process engineering, maintenance, plant materials, and quality assurance.

Designed for an agile, floor-focused manufacturing executive, this role requires deep experience navigating high-complexity, multi-line production environments. The Plant Director will leverage advanced Lean methodologies and structured problem-solving to eliminate operational drag, maximize line efficiency, and cultivate a disciplined, safety-first factory culture across all shift teams.

Core Responsibilities

* **Plant Operations & Performance:**
  Lead day-to-day manufacturing operations, material flow, and plant capacity utilization to hit target daily throughput and schedule attainment.
* **Lean Transformation:**
  Lead plant-wide deployment of Lean production models, daily Visual Management, standard work, and rapid kaizen execution to continually lower conversion costs and waste.
* **Plant Financial Accountability:**
  Manage site operational expenses (OpEx), direct/indirect labor utilization, scrap rates, and plant maintenance budgets to drive cost-per-unit reductions.
* **Safety & Regulatory Compliance:**
  Enforce rigorous OSHA, environmental (EHS), and quality compliance standards, fostering a proactive zero-incident floor culture.
* **Factory Leadership & Talent:**
  Direct and mentor department managers, line supervisors, and floor engineers; build a resilient, high-accountability production workforce across all shifts.

Required Qualifications

* **Prerequisite Certification:**
  **Lean Six Sigma Black Belt**
  certification required for consideration.
* **Experience:**
  8+ years of plant leadership experience in a high-complexity manufacturing facility (e.g., precision machining, complex assembly, automotive tier-1, aerospace, or specialty chemical/materials), with direct plant head or operations director experience.
* **Technical Mastery:**
  Proven expertise in Lean manufacturing tools, Value Stream Mapping, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Root Cause Analysis (8D/A3), and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) optimization.
* **Education:**
  B.S. in Engineering, Industrial Technology, or Operations Management.
* **Operational Acumen:**
  Demonstrated mastery in labor management, shop-floor scheduling, ERP/MES software utilization, and direct plant budget administration.

Compensation & Benefits

They offer a competitive compensation package that includes full health/wellness benefits, a 401(k) retirement plan, and equity options.

**Senior Manager, Quality Engineering**
position is a unique career opportunity that could be your next step towards an exciting future.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Quality Engineering is a people leadership and manufacturing role responsible for providing quality and compliance oversight. This leader will manage and develop a team of Quality Engineers while partnering closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to ensure manufacturing activities are performed safely, effectively, and in compliance with applicable quality system requirements.

The successful candidate will strengthen NCR and CAPA execution, improve investigation quality, monitor operational quality metrics, and establish effective communication and continuity.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Quality Engineers supporting manufacturing operations, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and individual development plans.

* Provide quality leadership for supplier-related issues, as applicable, including investigation support, corrective actions, and supplier performance concerns.

* Develop and implement quality processes that improve product compliance, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.

As a Senior Manager, LEU+ Manufacturing Process Engineering you will lead process engineering for the LEU+ Manufacturing Program, a capital expansion of Westinghouse's Columbia Fuel Fabrication Facility to manufacture LEU+ (higher-enrichment low-enriched uranium) nuclear fuel. Accountable for the design, qualification and startup of the new manufacturing processes, including uranium conversion, pellet production, fuel rod and assembly manufacturing, uranium recovery and recycling, and the laboratory and maintenance areas. Plans and directs the methods, equipment and processes needed to deliver safe, high-quality, cost-effective fuel, and develops the engineers who deliver them.

* Lead the LEU+ Process Engineering organization with responsibility for safety, regulatory compliance, product quality, technical execution, cost, schedule, and operational readiness.

* Oversee process engineering deliverables from initial design through equipment procurement, installation, commissioning, qualification, startup, and turnover to Operations.
* Ensure manufacturing equipment and processes meet product quality, nuclear safety, performance, and qualification requirements.

records.title: Director Operational Excellence
records.description:
**About Komline**

As a pioneering leader in advanced separation technologies, Komline has established a global reputation for engineering excellence. Through our combination of innovative design, cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities, and decades of industry experience, we consistently deliver the highest quality equipment from our integrated manufacturing facilities. Serving our core markets of Water & Process, Agricultural & Renewables, and Industrials, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive separation solutions precisely tailored to our clients' requirements. With a strong track record of strategic growth and acquisitions, Komline continues to expand its solution portfolio and technical capabilities while maintaining our commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

**This Opportunity**

The Director, Operational Excellence is responsible for building, deploying, and sustaining the Komline Business System (KBS), a consistent operating excellence system across all Komline sites. This leader will partner with Business Unit General Managers, Plant Managers, and functional leaders to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, working capital, productivity, and overall operating discipline while respecting the P&L accountability of each business. The role will lead Komline’s enterprise continuous improvement (CI) capability, develop CI talent, and ensure proven practices are shared and scaled across the network.

The successful candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who combines strong Lean expertise with business judgment, credibility on the shop floor, and the executive presence to influence decentralized business leaders. This leader will be equally comfortable coaching a plant team, challenging a site improvement plan, and communicating enterprise priorities to senior leadership.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this enterprise-wide role supports all Komline operating sites.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead implementation of the KBS Operational Excellence strategy, roadmap, standards, and multi-year improvement agenda across all sites
* Lead, coach, and develop the CI Manager team and other improvement resources; establish clear site coverage, priorities, and deployment expectations
* Partner with GMs and Plant Managers to identify the highest-impact opportunities and build robust, financially validated site-level improvement pipelines that deliver sustained results in safety, productivity, delivery, lead time, quality, inventory, cost, and working capital
* Establish and sustain common Lean / KBS operating practices, including daily management, visual management, standard work, problem solving, RCCM, value-stream improvement, kaizen, and leader standard work
* Create a practical maturity assessment for Operational Excellence and use it to prioritize coaching, capability building, and site support; track improvements in maturity and consistent adoption of core operating practices
* Drive measurable productivity and capacity improvements through flow, labor optimization, constraint removal, setup reduction, layout improvement, and waste elimination
* Partner with Industrial Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, EHS, Finance, Engineering, HR, and other enterprise functions to quantify benefits and ensure improvements are sustained
* Build CI capability within site leadership and frontline teams through training, coaching, kaizen leadership, and development of local change agents
* Establish common operational KPI definitions and review routines that enable benchmarking and the sharing and scaling of best practices across Komline
* Support acquisition integration by assessing operational maturity, identifying improvement opportunities, and integrating acquired sites into Komline’s operating system
* Provide regular enterprise-level reporting to the COO on CI pipeline, benefits realization, site maturity, risks, and resource priorities
* Promote a culture of accountability, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement while maintaining strong partnership with decentralized business leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, operational excellence, industrial engineering, or related leadership roles
* Demonstrated success leading Lean / continuous improvement across multiple sites or business units
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, daily management, kaizen, standard work, value-stream mapping, structured problem solving, and performance management
* Proven ability to influence GMs, Plant Managers, and functional leaders without relying on direct authority
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to translate operational improvements into measurable financial impact
* Excellent leadership, coaching, facilitation, communication, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to travel approximately 50%+, depending on site and project needs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean leadership certification or equivalent and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
* Experience in multi-site industrial, engineered-product, capital-equipment, or process-equipment manufacturing
* Experience integrating acquired businesses or deploying a common operating system across decentralized businesses
* Experience with plant layout, flow optimization, capacity improvement, and working-capital initiatives
* MBA or advanced technical/operations degree

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**
Komline is an EEO employer – M/F/Vets/Disabled

records.title: Director of Operational Excellence
records.description:
Are you motivated by the challenge of solving complex, enterprise-wide problems? Do you love asking "why" and transforming good operations into exceptional public experiences? If so, consider joining the State of Missouri as our next Director of Operational Excellence!
  
  
In this pivotal leadership role you will champion continuous improvement across state government, lead our operational initiatives, and oversee our statewide customer experience program. This position resides within the Office of Administration, the administrative arm of the executive branch, but leads efforts that span all executive agencies to improve service delivery to the citizens of Missouri.
  
  
We are seeking an energetic, visionary executive to lead and empower a dedicated team of process improvement and customer experience efforts while serving as a strategic partner to executive leadership, agency partners, and frontline public servants. Our next director is a bridge-builder who combines proven improvement methodologies with human-centered design, modern customer experience principles, rapid responsiveness to agency partner needs, and a passion for coaching state team members to achieve measurable public outcomes.
  
  
In addition to the inspiring work that will improve the services provided by state government and your colleagues work environment, you will receive a great benefits package that includes paid time off, medical/vision/dental insurance, life insurance, and retirement.
  
  
The salary indicated represents a base pay rate. If the individual selected or the position is eligible for a pay differential (e.g., shift, security, or years of service), it will be added to the total compensation in your paycheck. A pay differential does not raise your base pay.
  
  

* Work collaboratively with leadership and teams to encourage, develop, and execute strategies to create a culture of continuous improvement across Missouri state government. Measure the effectiveness of improvements and provide administration with visibility to such improvements.
* Act as a subject matter expert and promote change management by sharing Lean Six Sigma and other Operational Excellence best practices. Teach, mentor, coach and lead Operational Excellence leaders from every state department.
* Continuously provide helpful operational excellence resources for team members and facilitate training sessions.
* Model excellence in leadership and act with urgency to achieve results and lead efforts to cultivate a culture of data-based decision making.
* Facilitate, lead, and oversee state level strategic initiatives and other projects as assigned by leadership.
* Coordinate and host an annual Show Me Excellence Summit and represent the State of Missouri at national operational excellence events.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Formal training in Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent continuous process improvement framework. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge in Lean and Operational Excellence frameworks and facilitation methodologies
* Hands-on experience work with survey, feedback, or data visualization platforms, such as Qualtrics, Tableau, or Power BI

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Must be action oriented, demonstrate superior organizational abilities and have strong facilitation skills and excellent communications skills.
* Ability to work with leaders and multi-level teams to establish goals, performance indicators, actions plans and deliverables and effectively communicating across broad audiences.
* Must have excellent leadership abilities. This individual must be an effective collaborator with energy, enthusiasm and a can-do attitude who can empower others, gain buy-in and achieve results.
* Good understanding of data analysis related to process improvement and an ability to analyze data to gain insights and support problem solving.
* Training, certification, and/or education in continuous process improvement programs such as Lean Six Sigma as well as completion of Missouri Way, Leadership Academy, and similar programs is preferred.

**Lack of post**
**‐secondary education will not be used as the sole basis denying consideration to any applicant.**
Successful background check results are required for employment in this position. This may include background checks involving a candidate's name and/or fingerprints and other screenings as needed for the specific position.
  
  
Authorization to work in the United States is a prerequisite of employment. The Office of Administration will not sponsor applicants for work visas.
  
  
The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. To help demonstrate the value of working for the State of Missouri, we have created an interactive Total Compensation Calculator. This tool provides a comprehensive view of benefits and more that are offered to prospective employees. The Total Compensation Calculator and other applicant resources can be found here.

records.title: Director, Manufacturing Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Overview**

Lead the development and execution of the organization's Continuous Improvement strategy across manufacturing operations. Drive a culture of Operational Excellence through Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma methodologies, waste elimination, process standardization, employee engagement, and data-driven decision making. Partner with factory leadership to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity while supporting the growth and scalability of luxury furniture manufacturing operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and deploy a comprehensive Continuous Improvement roadmap aligned with company strategic objectives.
* Serve as the Lean Manufacturing subject matter expert and champion Operational Excellence initiatives throughout the organization.
* Lead Kaizen events, Rapid Improvement Workshops, Gemba walks, Value Stream Mapping activities, and cross-functional improvement projects.
* Drive measurable improvements in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Morale (SQDCM).
* Identify and eliminate waste utilizing Lean principles, including Transportation, Inventory, Motion, Waiting, Overproduction, Overprocessing, Defects, and Underutilized Talent.
* Establish and sustain standardized work, visual management systems, layered audits, and accountability processes.
* Facilitate implementation and sustainment of 5S and workplace organization initiatives across all departments.
* Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), scorecards, dashboards, and reporting systems to monitor operational performance.
* Utilize root cause analysis methodologies including A3 Problem Solving, 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
* Lead process improvement projects focused on throughput, labor efficiency, productivity, quality, material flow, inventory optimization, and lead-time reduction.
* Partner with Production, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Product Development teams to support business objectives.
* Drive employee engagement through CI training, mentoring, coaching, and change management initiatives.
* Develop future CI leaders and establish a culture of continuous learning and problem-solving.
* Identify opportunities to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), capacity utilization, and operational throughput.
* Evaluate and implement best practices related to Lean Enterprise systems and manufacturing excellence.
* Support facility expansion, capital projects, new product launches, and operational scaling activities.
* Present improvement plans and results to executive leadership using data-driven analysis.
* Provide leadership for strategic initiatives focused on cost reduction, quality enhancement, associate development, and customer satisfaction.
* Other duties as required.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt Certification.
* 5+ years leading Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, Industrial Engineering, or related initiatives.
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean transformations and culture change initiatives in manufacturing environments.
* Extensive experience in labor-intensive and/or high-tech manufacturing environments preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership of multi-site Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, and Operational Excellence initiatives strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Toyota Production System (TPS), Six Sigma, and Operational Excellence methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead enterprise-wide culture transformation initiatives.
* Advanced knowledge of Value Stream Mapping, Standard Work, Kanban, Pull Systems, Heijunka,SMED, Poka-Yoke, TPM, and Visual Management.
* Strong project management, organizational, and communication skills.
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and data analysis tools.
* Strong financial acumen with the ability to quantify business impact and ROI.
* Ability to influence and lead through all levels of the organization.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Demonstrated change management and coaching skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple strategic initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
* Must be able to work effectively within production and office environments.
* Must be able to walk, stand, and observe production processes for extended periods.
* Must be able to occasionally lift to 30 pounds.
* Must be able to wear required PPE while in manufacturing areas.
* Must adhere to all company safety standards and procedures.
* Must be committed to a culture of safety, accountability, respect, and continuous improvement.

Arhaus is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Arhaus are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. records.description:
Fluidra is looking for a
**Director of Operational Excellence – North America**
to join our team in our Portland, TN facility.
**This does require relocation if currently located elsewhere.**
****WHAT YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE****
We are seeking a driven, enthusiastic, and experienced Director of Operational Excellence to lead Fluidra’s efforts in process improvement, operational efficiency, and organizational transformation. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of driving operational excellence initiatives, leading change, and achieving measurable results across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Inventory, and People (SQDCIP).
  
  
In This Strategic Leadership Role, You Will Identify Opportunities For Improvement, Design And Deploy Enterprise-wide Initiatives, Instill a Culture Of Continuous Improvement, And Champion The Implementation Of The Fluidra Operating System (FOS). Additionally, You Will:
  
  
**Leadership & Strategy**

* Drive the design, implementation, and execution of company-wide improvement strategies aligned with enterprise objectives.
* Lead organizational transformation through change management best practices.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement by coaching leaders and teams in the Fluidra Operating System (FOS).
* Partner with senior management to align OPEX initiatives with business strategy and long-term goals.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Performance**

* Identify and evaluate areas of operational inefficiency; develop and execute improvement plans, including footprint rationalization.
* Lead cross-functional teams in the adoption and deployment of the Fluidra Operating System (FOS).
* Conduct Lean audits, Kaizen events, and site maturity assessments, ensuring long-term facilities maintain a minimum Lean score of 3.0.
* Monitor, analyze, and report KPIs to drive data-based decision-making.
* Deliver sustainable improvements across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Inventory.

**Technical & Analytical Leadership**

* Apply the FOS other OPEX/Six-Sigma methodologies to guide improvement initiatives.
* Utilize data analysis and performance metrics to assess operational health.
* Drive multi-million-dollar cost savings through systematic improvement.
* Support creation and implementation of enterprise-level operations systems and digital performance tools.

**Talent Development & Leadership**

* Inspire, motivate, and develop leaders and teams to build a continuous improvement culture.
* Provide coaching, mentorship, and structured training.
* Lead succession planning and talent development across operations.

****WHAT WE SEEK****

* 8+ years of experience in Operational Excellence, manufacturing process improvement, or Operations leadership.
* Demonstrated success delivering sustainable operational improvements.
* Experience influencing at all organizational levels.
* Proficiency in Lean, Six Sigma, and/or Kaizen methodologies.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* Experience managing multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Proficiency with ERP systems (EPICOR, SAP preferred) and data tools (Power BI).

****PREFERRED:****

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification.
* Experience creating enterprise-level operational systems and digital tools.
* Proven capability developing and mentoring high-performance teams.

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Manufacturing Optimization
* Lean & Six Sigma Leadership
* Financial Acumen & Cost Control
* Change Management & Cultural Transformation
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Results Orientation
* Talent Development & Succession Planning

**EDUCATION**
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or related field.
  
  
****PREFERRED:****
Master’s degree or MBA.
  
  
****WHAT WE OFFER****
An exciting opportunity to dive in and begin your career with a company that offers a competitive total rewards package that includes:
  
  

* 3 weeks of paid vacation
* 11 paid Holidays
* Full range of health benefits including medical, dental & vision, short & long-term disability
* 401(K) matching (100% of first 3% contributed, 50% of the next 2%)
* Health and wellness programs / gym reimbursement
* Educational assistance up to $7,000 per year
* Company sponsored FUN events!
* Generous product discounts

****WHO WE ARE****
Fluidra is a publicly listed company focused on developing innovative products, services and IoT solutions for the residential, commercial and wellness pool markets, globally. The company operates in over 45 countries, has over 7,000 employees and owns a portfolio of some of the industry’s most recognized and trusted brands: Polaris®, Jandy®, CMP®, S.R. Smith®, and Zodiac®. We also sell products under the Cover‐Pools®, iAquaLink®, Grand Effects®, Del® and Nature2® names. With these combined resources we’re able accelerate innovation in critical areas like energy-efficiency, robotics and the Internet of Things.
  
  
Our focus is on creating the perfect pool and wellness experience responsibly. We take our mission to heart, and our employees embody these guiding principles in everything we do:
*passion for success, honesty & trust, customer collaboration, teamwork and inclusion, learn and adapt,*
excellence and innovation.
  
  
Don't meet every single requirement listed? At Fluidra, we thrive on building an inclusive workspace, so if you are excited about this role and your past experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may be just the right candidate for this role or another role in the organization. Fluidra is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Fluidra recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any legally protected characteristic.

records.description:
**Company Description**
The Wonderful Company is committed to providing high-quality, healthy, and iconic brands, including FIJI Water, POM Wonderful, Wonderful Pistachios, Wonderful Halos and helping improve the lives of the people who live and work in the places where we operate. Ranked No. 1 on the 2025 PEOPLE® Companies That Care list and one of Fortune® magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” in the U.S., The Wonderful Company is continually recognized for its dedication to the well-being of its workforce, their communities, and the planet.
  
  
Since 1996, FIJI Water has embodied what it means to be Earth's Finest Water®. Sourced from the islands of Fiji, FIJI Water is the No. 1 premium imported bottled water brand in the United States, and America’s Favorite Bottled Water Brand. FIJI Water is sold in more than 80 countries worldwide, known for its iconic square bottle, unique mineral profile, and soft smooth taste. Sourced from a natural artesian aquifer in the islands of Fiji, the difference is the source – FIJI Water gathers natural electrolytes and minerals and maintains a perfectly balanced pH.
  
  
FIJI Water is committed to doing business responsibly and seeking opportunities to make a difference. That commitment extends to the FIJI Water Foundation – one of the largest philanthropic organizations in Fiji – which focuses its efforts and investments on education, clean water access, environmental sustainability, health and wellness, emergency relief, and community development.
  
  
The Director of Strategy and Continuous Improvement (CI) collaborates with executive leaders to identify and tackle pressing strategic challenges, develop growth strategies, enhance operational and technological efficiencies utilizing lean principles to deliver financial and organizational benefits. This position will develop and utilize its holistic team, including a Project Management Office, and partner with functional areas within FIJI Water to support the ongoing growth of the brand. Areas of focus include: Supply Chain, Operations, Production, Maintenance & Reliability, Quality, HR, Finance, Sales and Management Infrastructure.
  
  
**Up to 25% travel is required in this role, both internationally to Fiji and domestically within the United States.**
This position will be based at our West Los Angeles, CA office. We work a hybrid schedule with an in-office requirement Monday-Wednesday and the option to work remotely on Thursday and Friday.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Lead high-impact strategic, commercial, and operational initiatives from concept through implementation, ensuring successful execution and measurable business results.
* Develop and execute strategic plans that support long-term business priorities and operational excellence.
* Build strong partnerships with senior leaders to identify opportunities, align stakeholders, and drive organizational change.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Continuous Improvement team, prioritizing work across multiple initiatives to maximize business impact and supporting travel and on-site work as needed.
* Oversee the FIJI Water Project Management Office (PMO), ensuring effective project governance, portfolio management, and execution via Senior Manager of PMO.
* Develop organizational Continuous Improvement capabilities through coaching, training, workshops, and leadership development.
* Champion Lean, problem-solving, and change management methodologies to improve processes, eliminate waste, and build a culture of continuous improvement.
* Lead cross-functional teams to investigate business challenges, identify root causes, and implement sustainable process improvements and best practices.
* Establish standardized processes, performance measures, and management systems that improve operational effectiveness and scalability.
